jobs.description: Reference code: JR127327 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Within Group HR Digital & Data, reporting to the HR Digital Transformation program Director, you will play a pivotal role in the digital transformation of our HR function supporting our evolving business and people strategy. We encourage anyone with strong Project Management experience to apply. You will lead impactful and innovative HR projects across all phases, from conception through management and operationalization. You will also coordinate change/enhancement processes and play a role of integrator in transversal end-to-end transformation projects. You will also be a reference when it comes to HR project management and related best practices. You will be a key pillar of the HR project managers community and will share your knowledge, and leverage other colleagues’ experience in designing scalable, global solutions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Project Management Plan, drive and support multiple projects in parallel; aligning with HR stakeholders, ensuring milestones are met and providing visibility to Senior Management. Prepare project reporting incl. Steering Committee presentations around ongoing projects. Track and support the continuing roll-out of HR Digital solutions into new markets, new Maisons, and new functionalities. Work in strong partnership with Group HR, Group HRIS and Group Product Office to ensure timely delivery of enhancements to Workday and other tools. Escalate risk to Senior Management & propose mitigation actions to avoid deviation from project plan. Change Management Ensure Change Management is part of project management key stream Be a reference when it comes to Change Management best practices and share your knowledge and experience with other Project Managers Liaise with GPO Change&Adoption team to ensure we are best leveraging Group framework and tools. Support colleagues in their change management strategy definition. Portfolio Consolidation & Monitoring Manage the Function’s project pipeline in Monday.com. Champion user adoption in the platform & track relevant KPIs. Facilitate the prioritization exercise between incoming projects for the platform. Liaise with Monday.com Product Owner to ensure usage follows best in class ways of working. Animate the project managers community through rituals and ceremony around the portfolio management. Define and share best practices within the PM community HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? A Master’s degree and 7+ years of experience in consulting and project management, with a sound knowledge of digital transformation and change management. A strong willingness to learn about HR strategic issues and processes. Results driven with a rigorous approach supported by proven methodologies. A strong team player and recognized for openness, sociability and assertiveness. A capacity to navigate well in a multi-cultural environment and complex organization and through uncertain times. Excel in communication, presentations & influencing skills and fluent in English and French. Other language(s) spoken (particularly Chinese, Portuguese or German) would be a plus. Experiences with Workday or Monday.com would be a plus. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value Excellence, Creativity, Responsibility, Entrepreneurial Spirit, Respect and Integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs HR Manager Save Mexico City, Mexico Richemont Group Compensation Specialist Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Internal Communication Senior Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Richemont possiede alcune delle case di lusso più prestigiose al mondo, con particolare forza in gioielli, orologi di lusso e accessori di lusso. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati a innovare e creare nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. COME SARÀ IL TUO IMPATTO? All'interno del Group HR Digital & Data, che risponde al direttore del programma di trasformazione digitale, avrai un ruolo cruciale nella trasformazione digitale della nostra funzione HR, sostenendo la nostra strategia aziendale e di persone in evoluzione. Incoraggiamo chiunque abbia esperienza solida in gestione dei progetti a applicarsi. Sarai responsabile di progetti HR innovativi e di alto impatto in tutte le fasi, dalla concezione alla gestione e all'operativizzazione. Sarai anche responsabile di processi di cambiamento e di integrazione in progetti di trasformazione end-to-end transversal. Sarai anche una fonte di riferimento per la gestione dei progetti HR e le migliori pratiche correlate. Sarai una colonna portante della comunità dei gestori di progetti HR e condividerai la tua conoscenza e avrai accesso all'esperienza di altri colleghi per progettare soluzioni scalabili e globali. RUOLO CENTRALI: Piano di Gestione dei Progetti, guidare e supportare più progetti in parallelo; allinearsi con gli stakeholder HR, assicurando che i marchi siano raggiunti e fornendo visibilità al Management Seniore. Preparare il rapporto di progetto, inclusi i presentazioni del Comitato di Direzione per i progetti in corso. Seguire e supportare il lancio continuo delle soluzioni digitali HR in nuovi mercati, nuove Maisons e nuove funzionalità. Lavora in forte partnership con Group HR, Group HRIS e Group Product Office per assicurare il rispetto delle scadenze per le miglioramenti di Workday e altri strumenti. Escalare i rischi al Management Seniore e proporre azioni di mitigazione per evitare la divergenza dal piano del progetto. Gestione del Cambiamento Assicurarsi che la gestione del cambiamento sia parte della gestione dei progetti chiave. Sarai una fonte di riferimento per le migliori pratiche di gestione del cambiamento e condividerai la tua conoscenza e esperienza con altri gestori di progetti. Collaborare con il team GPO Change&Adoption per assicurarsi che stiamo sfruttando al meglio il framework e gli strumenti del gruppo. Supportare i colleghi nella definizione della strategia di cambiamento. Consolidamento e Monitoraggio del Portafoglio Gestire la pipeline dei progetti della funzione in Monday.com. Promuovere l'adozione degli utenti nella piattaforma e tracciare i KPI rilevanti. Facilitare l'esercizio di priorizzazione tra i progetti in arrivo per la piattaforma. Collaborare con il Product Owner di Monday.com per assicurarsi che l'uso segua i migliori modi di lavorare. Animare la comunità dei gestori di progetti attraverso rituali e cerimonie intorno alla gestione del portafoglio. Definire e condividere le migliori pratiche all'interno della comunità dei PM.

descriptionByLocale.de: Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter-Häuser, insbesondere in Schmuck, hochwertige Uhren und Premium-Zubehör. Jedes Haus repräsentiert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerk und Richemont sucht, die Tradition und Identität jedes seiner Häuser zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir bestrebt, innovative Produkte zu entwickeln, die den Werten unserer Häuser entsprechen, durch einen kontinuierlichen Kreativitätsprozess. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Im Group HR Digital & Data, berichtend an den HR-Digital-Transformations-Programm-Direktor, wird Ihr Einfluss auf die digitale Transformation unserer HR-Funktion und unsere sich weiterentwickelnde Geschäfts- und Personalstrategie ausmachen. Wir ermutigen alle, die eine starke Projektmanagement-Erfahrung haben, sich anzumelden. Sie werden maßgeblich an innovativen HR-Projekten in allen Phasen von der Konzeption bis zur Verwaltung und Operationalisierung beteiligt sein. Sie werden auch die Veränderungs- und Verbesserungsprozesse koordinieren und eine Rolle als Integrator in transversal end-to-end-Transformationsprojekten spielen. Sie werden auch eine Referenz für HR-Projektmanagement und verwandte Best Practices sein. Sie werden eine zentrale Säule der HR-Projektmanager-Community sein und Ihre Kenntnisse teilen und von den Erfahrungen anderer Kollegen nutzen, um skalierbare, globale Lösungen zu gestalten. WICHTIGE VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN: Projektmanagement-Plan, führen und unterstützen mehrere Projekte parallel; ausrichten mit HR-Stakeholdern, sicherstellen, dass Meilensteine erreicht werden und Senior-Management Transparenz bieten. Projektberichte vorbereiten, einschließlich Steering-Committee-Präsentationen zu laufenden Projekten. Fortlaufende Implementierung von HR-Digital-Lösungen in neue Märkte, neue Maisons und neue Funktionalitäten überwachen und unterstützen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Group HR, Group HRIS und Group Product Office sicherstellen, dass Verbesserungen für Workday und andere Tools pünktlich geliefert werden. Risiken an Senior-Management weiterleiten und Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung vorschlagen, um von dem Projektplan abzuweichen. Change Management Stellen Sie sicher, dass Change Management ein zentraler Bestandteil der Projektmanagement-Schlange ist. Seien Sie eine Referenz für Change Management Best Practices und teilen Sie Ihre Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit anderen Projektmanagern. Mit dem GPO Change&Adoption-Team kooperieren, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die besten Möglichkeiten des Gruppenrahmens und -werkzeuge nutzen. Kollegen bei der Definition der Change-Management-Strategie unterstützen. Portfoli-Konsolidierung & -Überwachung: Die Projektpipeline der Funktion in Monday.com verwalten. Nutzerakzeptanz in der Plattform fördern und relevante KPIs verfolgen. Priorisierungsexercise zwischen eingehenden Projekten für die Plattform fördern. Mit dem Monday.com Product Owner kooperieren, um sicherzustellen, dass der Einsatz den besten Arbeitsweisen folgt. Die Projektmanager-Community durch Rituale und Zeremonien um den Portfolio-Management animieren. Best Practices innerhalb der PM-Community definieren und teilen.

jobs.description: Reference code: JR127279 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION : The Enterprise Architect for OS & BF plays a strategic role within Group Technology by shaping and evolving the architectural landscape across foundational business domains such as Finance, HR, Procurement, Manufacturing , Traceability, Logistics, Supply Chain, and Omnichannel Operations. This role ensures that enterprise architecture provides a coherent, scalable, and business‑aligned blueprint for these vertical capabilities, enabling Richemont’s Maisons and Group Functions to operate efficiently and transform effectively. While business domains define strategy, capabilities, and process priorities, the OS & BF Enterprise Architect ensures that these ambitions are translated into robust, sustainable, and standardized technology architectures. Acting as the architectural referent for domain‑specific solution architects and program teams, this role defines the structure, principles, and patterns that guide solution design, promote harmonization, and ensure long‑term platform viability. A critical success factor for this role is the close collaboration with business stakeholders, solution architects, enterprise architecture peers, and technology teams to ensure that designs remain coherent across domains, compliant with Group Technology standards, and aligned with global transformation trajectories HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Provide domain specific architectural leadership Serve as the architecture authority for all OS & BF functional domains, defining how application, data, and integration landscapes should evolve to support business strategy. Translate business capability needs into target architectures, high level designs, and actionable architectural guidance. Guide and harmonize solution delivery Support and coach solution architects across Finance, HR, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Supply Chain, and Omnichannel programs. Ensure that solutions adhere to enterprise principles, domain boundaries, integration standards, and technology guardrails. Lead and animate design authorities Chair or co-chair Design Authority sessions for OS & BF, ensuring consistent architectural decision making. Validate solution designs and manage architectural risks, tradeoffs, and technical debt considerations. Define and maintain domain reference architectures Build and update business capability maps, target state blueprints, domain architecture models, and transition roadmaps. Provide reusable patterns, architectural building blocks, and guidelines specific to OS & BF domains. Support major transformation programs Engage with initiatives such as composable ERP modernization, manufacturing & supply chain digitization, traceability platform development, omnichannel platform evolution, HR platform enhancements, and procurement transformation. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Rattaché au Responsable Achats & Approvisionnements, votre mission sera clé : du pilotage stratégique de familles d’achats à la gestion de projets, vous aurez de nombreuses interactions autant en interne qu’avec notre écosystème externe. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Consolider le prévisionnel et piloter le budget Suivre les plans d’actions avec les partenaires (yc produit et qualité) Enrichir les revues familles hebdomadaires Préparer et animer les sourcing committees bi-mensuels Animer le processus PIC avec les approvisionneurs Animer le processus des achats stratégiques avec l’ensemble des partenaires internes et externes Monitorer le process d’évaluation de performance des partenaires Etre Partie prenante du Make or Buy de la manufacture via votre implication dans le choix des partenaires pour les nouveaux projets Vous assurer de l’intégrité des données de gestion impactant les achats et coordonner les corrections nécessaires COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Vous êtes diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou de commerce avec une spécialisation Supply Chain et/ou Achats Vous êtes doté d’une expérience professionnelle confirmée de 5 ans sur un périmètre similaire (category management / Achats famille avec une forte exposition à la stratégie de l’entreprise). Vous êtes investi et engagé, avec la capacité d’aller au bout de vos sujets. Vous savez demander de l’appui quand c’est nécessaire pour vous permettre d’avancer et savez avoir le bon niveau de synchronisation avec votre hiérarchie. Doté d’un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, vous êtes force de proposition et orienté solution. Votre excellente capacité d’adaptation vous permet de vous intégrer au sein d’un environnement complexe, possédant des interactions transverses et d’évoluer au sein d’une équipe multi-métier. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux. Votre sens aiguisé de la gestion des priorités vous permet de faire aboutir des projets complexes dans le respect des délais qui vous sont impartis. Vous possédez de fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles : votre aisance relationnelle, votre écoute active et votre sens de la diplomatie vous permettent de faire adhérer vos interlocuteurs à vos enjeux. Vous êtes doté de bonnes connaissances en termes de concepts logistiques et/ou des achats stratégiques et projets (MRP, lean manufacturing, Category management) Votre maitrise des outils informatiques usuels (notamment power point). La connaissance de SAP est un atout. Vous avez des connaissances ainsi qu’une appétence pour le monde horloger. Vous maîtrisez la langue française. Un niveau intermédiaire en anglais serait un plus. QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Rejoignez un environnement de travail stimulant où l'héritage de l'horlogerie de luxe rencontre l'innovation. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature complète sur notre site de carrières. jobs.title: Cloud Security Team Lead
jobs.description: Reference code: JR127407 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: As the Cloud Security Team Lead, you will play a crucial role in leading and guiding Cloud Security team within the Cloud Governance & Architecture pillar part of Cloud & DevOps Services. You will be responsible for ensuring the security of our cloud infrastructure and code, while fostering a culture of security awareness and best practices across the organization. Your leadership and expertise will be instrumental in enabling and enhancing our security posture, allowing for streamlined and secure cloud development and deployment processes. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Team Management: Lead a team of 4-6 individuals (internal and external), Lead by example Set clear roles and objectives for each internal and external team member and carry out regular performance reviews. Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to the team. Manage the team backlog and prioritize activities according to the roadmap with customer-oriented mindset and a culture of collaboration. Manage third-party suppliers within your perimeter and according to contracts and budget management. Cloud Security: Lead and enhance a complete stack of solutions for cloud security & DevSecOps management from a people, process, and technology standpoint. This includes but is not limited to CNAPP, SAST, SCA, secret detection, policy as code. Provide practical guidance to engineering and project teams to support the implementation of security controls, guidelines, and best practices. Be a driving element and enable greater cooperation between product teams, cybersecurity teams, and compliance functions, helping quantify the risk and define relevant control objectives and activities to secure cloud workloads. Contribute to cloud security governance (including management of frameworks, committees, building dedicated dashboards with associated KPIs, and evangelizing to other teams). HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience: Minimum 4-6 years of experience in a cloud environment, with a proven track record in developing and implementing effective cloud security solutions and managing security challenges. Technical Skills: Deep understanding of cloud providers' services, especially AWS or GCP, Alibaba Cloud is plus with one or more cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Security. Experience in managing and defining security in the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Strong understanding of OWASP TOP 10 and OWASP Testing Guide Understanding of data architecture, protection, and mitigating of data exfiltration risks on sensitive data (PII). Understanding of container technologies (Kubernetes, EKS, ACK). Hands-on experience with technology concepts such as Security Architecture, Automation & Configuration Management, Integration and Deployment (Terraform). Leadership Skills: Ability to lead and motivate a team. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to work autonomously and take initiative. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Ability to solve problems and make decisions. Project Management Skills: Experience in managing cloud security projects in an agile approach Ability to use project management tools (Confluence /Jira). Languages: Fluent in English, with also a good level of French. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a large, mature full cloud landscape with best-in-class security products giving many challenges and opportunities. You will work with a multicultural stakeholder (Maison’s and markets) and for a leading company in the luxury industry. Generous package including benefits like staff sales, relocation, insurance participation. You will be able to participate in conferences and summits about cloud providers' technologies, be involved in personal development (training, certifications) and provide guidance and feedback regarding technologies available in the market. You will be able to work with an open-minded and self-learner team in a cutting-edge technical environment to provide excellent value to the business. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Cloud Security Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Engineering & Product Development Platforms Technology Team Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Richemont possiede alcune delle case di lusso più prestigiose al mondo, con particolare forza in gioielli, orologi di lusso e accessori di lusso. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maisons. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati a innovare e creare nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. La tua missione: Come Lead di Team Cloud Security, giocherai un ruolo cruciale nel guidare e guidare il team di sicurezza cloud all'interno della pilastra di Governance & Architecture del Cloud & DevOps Services. Sarai responsabile per garantire la sicurezza della nostra infrastruttura cloud e del codice, mentre promuoverai una cultura di consapevolezza della sicurezza e delle migliori pratiche all'interno dell'organizzazione. Il tuo leadership e la tua esperienza saranno fondamentali per facilitare e migliorare la nostra posizione di sicurezza, permettendo processi di sviluppo e distribuzione cloud fluide e sicuri. Come farai un impatto? Gestione della squadra: Guida una squadra di 4-6 individui (interni ed esterni), guida per esempio. Imposta ruoli e obiettivi chiari per ciascun membro interno ed esterno della squadra e condurre revisioni di prestazioni regolari. Fornisci guida tecnica, mentoring e supporto alla squadra. Gestisci il backlog della squadra e priorizza le attività in base al piano con un mindset orientato al cliente e una cultura di collaborazione. Gestisci i fornitori terzi nel tuo ambito e secondo i contratti e la gestione del budget. Sicurezza cloud: Guida e migliorare un pilastro completo di soluzioni per la gestione della sicurezza cloud & DevSecOps da un punto di vista di persone, processi e tecnologie. Questo include ma non è limitato a CNAPP, SAST, SCA, rilevamento dei segreti, codice delle politiche. Fornisci guida pratica agli engineering e ai team di progetto per supportare l'implementazione dei controlli di sicurezza, linee guida e migliori pratiche. Sii un elemento motivatore e favorisca una maggiore cooperazione tra le team di prodotto, le funzioni di sicurezza cibernetica e le funzioni di conformità, aiutando a quantificare il rischio e definire obiettivi e attività di controllo rilevanti per proteggere i carichi di lavoro cloud. Contribuisci alla gestione della sicurezza cloud (incluse la gestione dei framewok, dei comitati, la costruzione di dashboard dedicati con KPI associati e l'evasione a altre squadre). Come troverai successo con noi? Esperienza: Minimo 4-6 anni di esperienza in un ambiente cloud, con una traccia dimostrata nel sviluppare e implementare soluzioni di sicurezza cloud efficaci e nel gestire le sfide di sicurezza. Competenze tecniche: Profondo comprensione dei servizi dei fornitori cloud, in particolare AWS o GCP, Alibaba Cloud è un plus con una o più certificazioni cloud come AWS Certified Security. Esperienza nella gestione e definizione della sicurezza nel ciclo di vita del software (SDLC). Buona comprensione degli OWASP TOP 10 e del OWASP Testing Guide. Comprensione dell'architettura dei dati, protezione e mitigazione dei rischi di esfiltramento dei dati sensibili (PII). Comprensione delle tecnologie di contenitore (Kubernetes, EKS, ACK). Esperienza pratica con concetti tecnici come Architettura della Sicurezza, Automazione & Gestione della Configurazione, Integrazione e Distribuzione (Terraform). Competenze di leadership: Capacità di guidare e motivare una squadra. Buone competenze comunicative, sia verbali che scritte. Capacità di lavorare autonomamente e prendere l'initiative. Capacità di gestire più compiti e rispettare i tempi. Capacità di risolvere problemi e prendere decisioni. Competenze di gestione dei progetti: Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di sicurezza cloud in un approccio agile. Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di gestione dei progetti (Confluence / Jira). Lingue: Fluent in English, con anche un buon livello di francese. Come manterrai il sorriso? In un vasto e maturo ambiente cloud con prodotti di sicurezza di classe mondiale offrendo molte sfide e opportunità. Lavorerai con una stakeholder multicultural (Maison’s e mercati) e per una leading company nel settore del lusso. Pacchetto generoso che include benefici come vendite aziendali, assistenza all'immigrazione, partecipazione all'assicurazione. Sarai in grado di partecipare a conferenze e summit sui tecnologie dei fornitori cloud, essere coinvolto nella crescita personale (addestramento, certificazioni) e fornire guida e feedback riguardo alle tecnologie disponibili sul mercato. Sarai in grado di lavorare con un team a mente aperta e autoapprendente in un ambiente tecnico all'avanguardia per fornire un valore eccellente al business.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter-Häuser, insbesondere in Schmuck, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Zubehör. Jedes Haus repräsentiert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerk und Richemont sucht, die Tradition und Identität jedes seiner Häuser zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir bestrebt, innovative Produkte zu entwickeln, die mit den Werten unserer Häuser übereinstimmen, durch einen kontinuierlichen Kreativitätsprozess. Ihre Mission: Als Lead des Cloud-Sicherheits-Teams spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Führung und Führung des Cloud-Sicherheits-Teams innerhalb der Cloud-Governance & Architecture-Pilz des Cloud & DevOps Services. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der Sicherheit unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur und des Codes, während Sie eine Kultur der Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Best Practices innerhalb der Organisation fördern. Ihre Führung und Ihr Fachwissen sind entscheidend, um unsere Sicherheitsposition zu ermöglichen und zu verbessern, was eine nahtlose und sichere Cloud-Entwicklung und -Deployment ermöglicht. Wie werden Sie einen Einfluss haben? Teamführung: Führen Sie eine Mannschaft von 4-6 Personen (intern und extern), führen Sie zum Beispiel. Setzen Sie klare Rollen und Ziele für jeden internen und externen Teammitglied und führen Sie regelmäßige Leistungsbewertungen durch. Geben Sie technische Führung, Mentoring und Unterstützung an die Mannschaft. Verwalten Sie das Team-Backlog und priorisieren Sie Aktivitäten gemäß dem Roadmap mit einem Kundenorientierten Ansatz und einer Kultur der Zusammenarbeit. Verwalten Sie Drittanbieter innerhalb Ihres Umfelds und gemäß den Verträgen und Budgetmanagement. Cloud-Sicherheit: Führen und verbessern Sie einen vollständigen Stapel von Lösungen für Cloud-Sicherheit & DevSecOps-Management aus einer Perspektive von Menschen, Prozessen und Technologie. Dies umfasst, aber ist nicht beschränkt auf CNAPP, SAST, SCA, Geheimdetektion, Policy as Code. Geben Sie praktische Führung an Engineering- und Projektteams, um die Implementierung von Sicherheitskontrollen, Richtlinien und Best Practices zu unterstützen. Seien Sie ein treibender Element und ermöglichen Sie eine größere Zusammenarbeit zwischen Produktteams, Cybersecurity-Teams und Compliance-Funktionen, indem Sie den Risiko quantifizieren und relevante Steuerungsziele und -aktivitäten definieren, um Cloud-Lastmengen zu sichern. Beitragen Sie zur Cloud-Sicherheits-Governance (einschließlich der Verwaltung von Frameworks, Committees, der Erstellung von dedizierten Dashboards mit zugeordneten KPIs und der Evangelisierung an andere Teams). Wie werden Sie mit uns erfolgreich sein? Erfahrung: Mindestens 4-6 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Cloud-Umgebung, mit einer beweisbaren Nachweis für die Entwicklung und Implementierung effektiver Cloud-Sicherheitslösungen und die Verwaltung von Sicherheitsproblemen. Technische Fähigkeiten: Tiefe Kenntnis der Cloud-Dienstleister, insbesondere AWS oder GCP, Alibaba Cloud ist Plus mit einer oder mehreren Cloud-Zertifikaten wie AWS Certified Security. Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und Definition der Sicherheit im Software-Entwicklungszyklus (SDLC). Gute Kenntnis der OWASP TOP 10 und OWASP Testing Guide. Verständnis der Datenarchitektur, -schutz und -mitigation von Daten-Exfiltrationsrisiken (PII). Verständnis von Container-Technologien (Kubernetes, EKS, ACK). Praktische Erfahrung mit Technologiekonzepten wie Sicherheitsarchitektur, Automatisierung & Konfigurationsmanagement, Integration und Deployment (Terraform). Führungsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, eine Mannschaft zu führen und zu motivieren. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich. Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und Initiative zu ergreifen. Fähigkeit, mehrere
• Aufgaben zu verwalten und Fristen einzuhalten. Fähigkeit, Probleme zu lösen und Entscheidungen zu treffen. Projektmanagementfähigkeiten: Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Cloud-Sicherheitsprojekten in einem agilen Ansatz. Fähigkeit, Projektmanagement-Tools (Confluence / Jira) zu verwenden. Sprachen: Fluent in English, mit auch einem guten Level von French. Wie halten Sie den Lächeln? In einer großen, maturen Full-Cloud-Landscape mit best-in-class-Sicherheitsprodukten, die viele Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten bieten. Sie werden mit einer multikulturellen Stakeholder (Maison’s und Märkte) arbeiten und für eine führende Firma im Luxussektor. Generöses Paket einschließlich Vorteilen wie Firmenverkauf, Umzugshilfe, Versicherungsbeteiligung. Sie werden in der Lage sein, an Konferenzen und Summits über Cloud-Provider-Technologien teilzunehmen, an persönlicher Entwicklung (Training, Zertifikate) beteiligt zu sein und Feedback und Ratschläge zu den Technologien geben, die im Markt verfügbar sind. Sie werden in der Lage sein, mit einem offener und selbstlernenden Team in einer klingen technologischen Umgebung zu arbeiten, um einen hervorragenden Wert für das Unternehmen zu liefern.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Richemont possède certaines des maisons de luxe les plus prestigieuses au monde, avec des forces particulières dans les bijoux, les montres de luxe et les accessoires de luxe. Chaque Maison représente une tradition orgogliosa de style, qualité et artigianato et Richemont cherche à préserver l'héritage et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. En même temps, nous sommes engagés à innover et à créer de nouveaux produits qui sont en ligne avec les valeurs de nos Maisons, par un processus de créativité continue.
• Votre mission: En tant que Chef d'équipe de sécurité cloud, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans la direction et la gestion de l'équipe de sécurité cloud au sein du pilier de gouvernance et d'architecture cloud du service cloud & DevOps. Vous serez responsable de la sécurité de notre infrastructure cloud et de notre code, tout en favorisant une culture de conscience de la sécurité et de meilleures pratiques au sein de l'organisation. Votre leadership et votre expertise seront essentiels pour faciliter et améliorer notre posture de sécurité, permettant des processus de développement et de déploiement cloud fluides et sécurisés. Comment allez-vous faire un impact? Gestion de l'équipe: Dirigez une équipe de 4-6 personnes (internes et externes), guidez par exemple. Fixez des rôles et des objectifs clairs pour chaque membre interne et externe de l'équipe et effectuez des évaluations de performance régulières. Fournissez un leadership technique, un mentorat et un soutien à l'équipe. Gérez le backlog de l'équipe et priorisez les activités selon le roadmap avec une approche centrée sur le client et une culture de collaboration. Gérez les fournisseurs tiers dans votre périmètre et selon les contrats et la gestion budgétaire. Sécurité cloud: Dirigez et améliorez un pilier complet de solutions pour la gestion de la sécurité cloud & DevSecOps à partir d'un point de vue de personnes, processus et technologies. Cela inclut, mais n'est pas limité à CNAPP, SAST, SCA, détection des secrets, code des politiques. Fournissez une guidance pratique aux équipes de développement et de projet pour soutenir l'implémentation des contrôles de sécurité, des lignes directrices et des meilleures pratiques. Soyez un élément motivatif et favorisez une coopération accrue entre les équipes de produit, les équipes de sécurité cybernétique et les fonctions de conformité, en aidant à quantifier le risque et à définir des objectifs et des activités de contrôle pertinents pour sécuriser les charges de travail cloud. Contribuez à la gouvernance de la sécurité cloud (y compris la gestion des frameworks, des comités, la construction de tableaux de bord dédiés avec des KPI associés et l'évangélisation auprès d'autres équipes). Comment réussirez-vous avec nous? Expérience: Minimum 4-6 ans d'expérience dans un environnement cloud, avec une trace prouvée dans le développement et l'implémentation de solutions de sécurité cloud efficaces et la gestion des défis de sécurité. Compétences techniques: Compréhension approfondie des services des fournisseurs cloud, notamment AWS ou GCP, Alibaba Cloud est plus avec une ou plusieurs certifications cloud comme AWS Certified Security. Expérience dans la gestion et la définition de la sécurité dans le cycle de vie du logiciel (SDLC). Compréhension des OWASP TOP 10 et du guide de test OWASP. Compréhension de l'architecture des données, de la protection et de la mitigation des risques d'exfiltration des données sensibles (PII). Compréhension des technologies de conteneurisation (Kubernetes, EKS, ACK). Expérience pratique avec des concepts technologiques tels que l'architecture de la sécurité, l'automatisation & la gestion de la configuration, l'intégration et le déploiement (Terraform). Compétences de leadership: Capacité à diriger et à motiver une équipe. Excellentes compétences en communication, à la fois orales et écrites. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre l'initiative. Capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches et respecter les délais. Capacité à résoudre des problèmes et à prendre des décisions. Compétences en gestion de projet: Expérience dans la gestion de projets de sécurité cloud dans une approche agile. Capacité à utiliser des outils de gestion de projet (Confluence / Jira). Langues: Fluent en anglais, avec également un bon niveau de français. Comment nous ferons sourire? Dans un vaste et mature paysage cloud avec des produits de sécurité de classe mondiale offrant de nombreuses défis et opportunités. Vous travaillerez avec une stakeholder multiculturelle (Maisons et marchés) et pour une entreprise de leader dans le secteur du luxe. Un paquet généreux incluant des avantages comme les ventes d'entreprise, l'aide au déménagement, la participation à l'assurance. Vous serez en mesure de participer à des conférences et des sommets sur les technologies des fournisseurs cloud, d'être impliqué dans le développement personnel (formation, certifications) et de fournir des conseils et des retours sur les technologies disponibles sur le marché. Vous serez en mesure de travailler avec une équipe à esprit ouvert et auto-apprenant dans un environnement technologique à la pointe pour fournir une valeur exceptionnelle à l'entreprise.

Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality, and craftsmanship, and Richemont is dedicated to preserving their unique heritage and identity. Simultaneously, we are committed to innovation and the creation of new products aligned with our Maisons' values, driven by a continuous creative process. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team, playing a pivotal role in coordinating jewelry operations across our European Maisons. This position is central to ensuring consistency, excellence, and strategic alignment in jewelry services and technical support throughout the region. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Regional Jewelry manager, you will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and strategic coordination across our European jewelry network. You will have the functional responsibility of local jewelry managers/team leaders. Main missions: Support the Region on all jewelry topics (e.g., continuous improvement, technical processes) Coordinate jewelry topics of the region, in close relationship with Maisons and central RCS Coordinate jewelry staffing and talent management Your key responsibilities will include: Performance & budget management: Manage regional jewelry budget (incl. Capex/Opex). Monitor and ensure performance (Quality, Leadtime, Efficiency). Coordinate team leaders to ensure operational tasks in platforms and boutiques. Guarantee comprehensive product knowledge (including novelties). Collect training needs and implement structured training paths for all jewelers (including beginners). Coordinate the team leaders to ensure they: Assess jewelers' skills during the recruitment process. Manage career path and development of jewelers within region. Oversee the operational management of all tools and equipment. Functional management of all jewelry workshop team leaders to ensure they : Drive and maintain rigorous quality monitoring standards for all jewelry operations. Develop, implement and guarantee adherence to diagnostic, repair and operational procedures. Manage workshop organization (platform & boutique) in line with regional standards. Propose workshop layout adjustments for new boutique creations or platform modifications. Answer technical inquiries from boutiques and deliver essential technical support to customer contact teams. External subcontracting management (in close collaboration with the European external network director) : Ensure/manage quality and lead-time of subcontractors Coordinate the sharing of technical documentation and related training. Manage the assessment and administrative coordination of bench tests of (new) partners up to contract management. Organize and facilitate network exchanges and visits of the network. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR127514 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. CONTEXT Richemont, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, comprende varie Maison specializzate in gioielli, orologi e accessori di fascia alta. Ogni Maison incarna orgogliosamente una tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianalità, e Richemont è dedicata a preservare il loro patrimonio unico e identità. Contemporaneamente, ci impegniamo all'innovazione e alla creazione di nuovi prodotti allineati ai valori delle nostre Maison, guidati da un continuo processo creativo. Questa è un'occasione unica per unire un team dinamico, giocando un ruolo fondamentale nel coordinamento delle operazioni di gioielli attraverso le nostre Maison europee. Questa posizione è centrale per garantire coerenza, eccellenza e allineamento strategico nei servizi di gioielli e supporto tecnico in tutta la regione. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In qualità di responsabile regionale dei gioielli, sarete strumentali nel guidare l'eccellenza operativa e la coordinazione strategica attraverso la nostra rete europea di gioielli. Avrete la responsabilità funzionale dei gestori di gioielli locali / leader del team. Principali missioni: Sostenere la Regione su tutti gli argomenti della gioielleria (ad esempio, miglioramento continuo, processi tecnici) Coordinate tematiche di gioielli della regione, in stretto rapporto con Maisons e il central RCS Coordinate bigiotteria e gestione del talento Le tue responsabilità chiave includono: Performance & budget management: Gestisci il budget dei gioielli regionali (incl. Capex/Opex). Monitorare e garantire le prestazioni (qualità, Leadtime, efficienza). Coordinate i leader del team per garantire compiti operativi in piattaforme e boutique. Guidare il monitoraggio delle capacità di alto livello a livello regionale e coordinare il monitoraggio delle capacità locali. Talent development & brand' policy coordinamento: Siate il punto di contatto tra le Maison e la regione / mercati / laboratori di gioielli per consolidare le esigenze in linea con la strategia. Garantire una conoscenza completa dei prodotti (comprese le novità). Raccogliere le esigenze di formazione e implementare percorsi formativi strutturati per tutti i gioiellieri (compresi i principianti). Coordinare i leader del team per garantire loro: Valutare le competenze dei gioiellieri durante il processo di reclutamento. Gestisci percorso di carriera e sviluppo di gioiellieri all'interno della regione. Assicurare l'implementazione coerente e l'adesione alle politiche di Maisons, gestire proattivamente i loro aggiornamenti e regolazioni. Supporto tecnico & eccellenza operativa: Servire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per Maisons in tutta la regione (compreso l'orientamento tecnico sui processi di riparazione), legare con i leader del team di officina di gioielli se del caso. Controllare la gestione operativa di tutti gli strumenti e le attrezzature. Gestione funzionale di tutti i leader del team di workshop di gioielli per garantire loro: guidare e mantenere rigorosi standard di monitoraggio della qualità per tutte le operazioni di gioielli. Sviluppare, implementare e garantire l'adesione a procedure diagnostiche, di riparazione e operative. Gestire l'organizzazione di workshop (piattaforma & boutique) in linea con gli standard regionali. Proporre modifiche layout workshop per nuove creazioni boutique o modifiche piattaforma. Rispondere alle richieste tecniche delle boutique e fornire un supporto tecnico essenziale ai team di contatto con i clienti. Gestione esterna dei subappalti (in stretta collaborazione con il direttore europeo della rete esterna) : Assicurare/gestire la qualità e il lead-time dei subappaltatori Coordinare la condivisione della documentazione tecnica e della relativa formazione. Gestire la valutazione e il coordinamento amministrativo dei test di banco dei partner (nuovi) fino alla gestione dei contratti. Organizzare e facilitare scambi di rete e visite della rete. Come fai a superare la nostra esperienza? Siamo alla ricerca di un individuo altamente organizzato e orientato al dettaglio con una forte mentalità collaborativa e un forte interesse per il business dei gioielli di lusso. Possiedi uno sfondo in operazioni di gioielli, servizi tecnici, o un campo correlato, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di lusso. Lei dimostra eccellenti competenze di coordinamento, comunicazione e interpersonale, consentendo una collaborazione efficace con diversi stakeholder in diversi siti di riparazione europei e Maisons. Hai dimostrato esperienza nella gestione dei budget, monitoraggio dei KPI e miglioramento delle prestazioni di guida. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT Richemont, a world leader in the luxury sector, encompasses various Maisons specializing in jewelry, watches, and high-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality, and craftsmanship, and Richemont is dedicated to preserving their unique heritage and identity. Simultaneously, we are committed to innovation and the creation of new products aligned with our Maisons' values, driven by a continuous creative process. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team, playing a pivotal role in coordinating jewelry operations across our European Maisons. This position is central to ensuring consistency, excellence, and strategic alignment in jewelry services and technical support throughout the region. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Regional Jewelry manager, you will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and strategic coordination across our European jewelry network. You will have the functional responsibility of local jewelry managers/team leaders. Main missions: Support the Region on all jewelry topics (e.g., continuous improvement, technical processes) Coordinate jewelry topics of the region, in close relationship with Maisons and central RCS Coordinate jewelry staffing and talent management Your key responsibilities will include: Performance & budget management: Manage regional jewelry budget (incl. Capex/Opex). Monitor and ensure performance (Quality, Leadtime, Efficiency). Coordinate team leaders to ensure operational tasks in platforms and boutiques. Drive high-level capacity monitoring on regional level and coordinate local capacity monitoring. Talent development & brands' policies coordination: Be the point of contact between the Maisons and the region / markets / jewelry workshops to consolidate needs in line with the strategy. Guarantee comprehensive product knowledge (including novelties). Collect training needs and implement structured training paths for all jewelers (including beginners). Coordinate the team leaders to ensure they: Assess jewelers' skills during the recruitment process. Manage career path and development of jewelers within region. Ensure consistent implementation and adherence to Maisons' policies, proactively manage their updates and adjustments. Technical support & operational excellence: Serve as the primary technical contact point for Maisons across the region (including technical guidance on repair processes), liaising with jewelry workshop team leaders when appropriate. Oversee the operational management of all tools and equipment. Functional management of all jewelry workshop team leaders to ensure they : Drive and maintain rigorous quality monitoring standards for all jewelry operations. Develop, implement and guarantee adherence to diagnostic, repair and operational procedures. Manage workshop organization (platform & boutique) in line with regional standards. Propose workshop layout adjustments for new boutique creations or platform modifications. Answer technical inquiries from boutiques and deliver essential technical support to customer contact teams. External subcontracting management (in close collaboration with the European external network director) : Ensure/manage quality and lead-time of subcontractors Coordinate the sharing of technical documentation and related training. Manage the assessment and administrative coordination of bench tests of (new) partners up to contract management. Organize and facilitate network exchanges and visits of the network. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US ? We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented individual with a strong collaborative mindset and a strong interest in the luxury jewelry business. You possess a background in jewelry operations, technical services, or a related field, ideally within a luxury environment. You demonstrate excellent coordination, communication, and interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with diverse stakeholders across multiple European repair sites and Maisons. You have proven experience in managing budgets, monitoring KPIs, and driving performance improvements. You are adept at providing technical expertise, developing operational procedures, and ensuring quality standards. Experience in training, knowledge transfer, and project coordination is highly valued. You are fluent in English; proficiency in French or other European languages is a strong asset. You are proactive, autonomous, and capable of driving initiatives from conception to completion. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Regional Jewelry Manager Save Dubai, United Arab Emirates Richemont Europe FP&A Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Client Services Project Manager Europe-CIS Save Geneva, Switzerland Van Cleef & Arpels
descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR127514 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusartikel Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, edlen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Maison ist eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerk und Richemont versucht, das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig setzen wir uns für die Innovation und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte ein, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. CONTEXT Richemont, Weltmarktführer im Luxusbereich, umfasst verschiedene Maisons, die sich auf Schmuck, Uhren und High-End-Accessoires spezialisiert haben. Jedes Maison verkörpert stolz eine Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerk, und Richemont ist gewidmet, um ihr einzigartiges Erbe und Identität zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig setzen wir uns für Innovation und die Schaffung neuer Produkte ein, die auf die Werte unserer Maisons ausgerichtet sind, die von einem kontinuierlichen kreativen Prozess angetrieben werden. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, sich einem dynamischen Team anzuschließen und eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Koordination von Schmuckgeschäften in unseren europäischen Maisons zu spielen. Diese Position ist von zentraler Bedeutung, um Konsistenz, Exzellenz und strategische Ausrichtung in Schmuckdienstleistungen und technische Unterstützung in der gesamten Region zu gewährleisten. Wie wär's, wenn du einen IMPACT machst? Als regionaler Schmuckmanager sind Sie maßgeblich an der operativen Exzellenz und strategischen Koordination in unserem europäischen Schmucknetzwerk beteiligt. Sie werden die funktionelle Verantwortung der lokalen Schmuck Manager / Dampfleiter haben. Hauptmissionen: Unterstützung der Region bei allen Schmuckthemen (z.B. kontinuierliche Verbesserung, technische Prozesse) Koordinierte Schmuckthemen der Region, in enger Beziehung zu Maisons und zentraler RCS Koordinierte Schmuckmitarbeiter und Talentmanagement Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben sind: Performance & Budget-Management: Regionales Schmuckbudget verwalten (inkl. Capex/Opex). Überwachung und Gewährleistung der Leistung (Qualität, Leadtime, Efficiency). Koordination der Teamleiter, um operative Aufgaben in Plattformen und Boutiquen zu gewährleisten. Führen Sie die Kapazitätsüberwachung auf regionaler Ebene aus und koordinieren Sie die lokale Kapazitätsüberwachung. Koordinierung der Strategien der Talententwicklung & Marken: Seien Sie der Ansprechpartner zwischen den Maisons und der Region / Märkte / Schmuckwerkstätten, um die Bedürfnisse im Einklang mit der Strategie zu konsolidieren. Garantie umfassendes Produktwissen (einschließlich Neuheiten). Sammeln Sie Trainingsbedürfnisse und implementieren Sie strukturierte Trainingswege für alle Juweliere (einschließlich Anfänger). Koordination der Teamleiter, um sicherzustellen, dass sie: Assess Jewelers' Fähigkeiten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses. Karriereweg und Entwicklung von Juwelen in der Region verwalten. Gewährleistung der konsequenten Umsetzung und Einhaltung der Maisons-Richtlinien, proaktiv verwalten ihre Updates und Anpassungen. Technische Unterstützung & operative Exzellenz: Als primärer technischer Kontaktpunkt für Maisons in der gesamten Region (einschließlich technischer Anleitungen für Reparaturprozesse) dienen und gegebenenfalls mit den Führungskräften der Schmuckwerkstatt zusammenarbeiten. Beaufsichtigen Sie das operative Management aller Werkzeuge und Geräte. Funktionelles Management aller Schmuckwerkstatt-Teamführer, um sicherzustellen, dass sie: Fahren und pflegen strenge Qualitätsüberwachungsstandards für alle Schmuckgeschäfte. Entwickeln, implementieren und garantieren die Einhaltung von Diagnose-, Reparatur- und Betriebsverfahren. Manage Workshop Organisation (Plattform & Boutique) in Übereinstimmung mit regionalen Standards. Requisite Werkstatt Layout Anpassungen für neue Boutique-Kreationen oder Plattform-Änderungen. Beantworten Sie technische Anfragen von Boutiquen und liefern Sie wesentliche technische Unterstützung an Kundenkontaktteams. Externes Unterauftragsmanagement (in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem europäischen externen Netzdirektor) : Gewährleistung/Verwaltung von Qualität und Vorlaufzeit von Unterauftragnehmern Koordination des Austauschs von technischen Unterlagen und damit zusammenhängenden Schulungen. Verwalten Sie die Bewertung und administrative Koordination von Banktests von (neuen) Partnern bis zur Vertragsverwaltung. Organisieren und erleichtern Netzwerkaustausch und Besuche des Netzwerks. Wie wär's, wenn du dich mit uns auskennst? Wir suchen ein hoch organisiertes und detailorientiertes Individuum mit einer starken kollaborativen Denkweise und einem starken Interesse am Luxusschmuckgeschäft. Sie besitzen einen Hintergrund in Schmuckgeschäften, technischen Dienstleistungen oder einem verwandten Bereich, ideal innerhalb einer Luxusumgebung. Sie zeigen hervorragende Koordination, Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und ermöglichen eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Interessenvertretern auf verschiedenen europäischen Reparaturstandorten und Maisons. Sie haben Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Budgets, der Überwachung von Kennzahlen und der Verbesserung der Leistung. Sie sind dabei, technische Expertise zu bieten, operative Verfahren zu entwickeln und Qualitätsstandards zu gewährleisten. Erfahrung in der Ausbildung, Wissenstransfer und Projektkoordination ist sehr geschätzt. Sie sind fließend auf Englisch; Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch oder anderen europäischen Sprachen sind ein starkes Gut. Sie sind proaktiv, autonom und in der Lage, Initiativen von der Konzeption bis zur Vollendung zu treiben. #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Regional Jewelry Manager Save Dubai, Vereinigte Arabische Emirate Richemont Europe FP&A Controller Save Meyrin, Schweiz Richemont Client Services Project Manager Europe-CIS Sparen Genf, Schweiz Van Cleef & Arpels
descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence : JR127514 Richemont possède certaines des principales maisons de luxe mondiales, avec des points forts particuliers dans les bijoux, les montres de haute qualité et les accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d’artisanat, et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l’identité de chacune de ses Maisons. En même temps, nous nous engageons dans l’innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits en accord avec les valeurs de nos Maisons, grâce à un processus de créativité continue. CONTEXTE Richemont, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, regroupe diverses maisons spécialisées dans la bijouterie, les montres et les accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison incarne fièrement une tradition de style, de qualité et d’artisanat, et Richemont s’engage à préserver son héritage et son identité uniques. Simultanément, nous nous engageons dans l’innovation et la création de nouveaux produits alignés sur les valeurs de nos Maisons, portés par un processus créatif continu. C’est une opportunité unique de rejoindre une équipe dynamique, jouant un rôle clé dans la coordination des opérations de bijouterie à travers nos maisons européennes. Ce poste est essentiel pour garantir la cohérence, l’excellence et l’alignement stratégique des services de joaillerie et du support technique dans toute la région. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? En tant que responsable régional de la joaillerie, vous serez déterminant dans la promotion de l’excellence opérationnelle et de la coordination stratégique à travers notre réseau européen de bijouterie. Vous aurez la responsabilité fonctionnelle des responsables locaux de la bijouterie et des chefs d’équipe. Missions principales : Soutenir la Région sur tous les sujets liés à la joaillerie (par exemple, amélioration continue, processus techniques) Coordonner les sujets de bijouterie de la région, en étroite collaboration avec les Maisons et le RCS central, coordonner le personnel de la joaillerie et la gestion des talents. Vos principales responsabilités incluront : Gestion de la performance et de la gestion du budget : Gérer le budget régional de la bijouterie (y compris Capex/Opex). Surveillez et assurez la performance (Qualité, Délai, Efficacité). Coordonnez les chefs d’équipe pour assurer les tâches opérationnelles sur les plateformes et les boutiques. Promouvoir un suivi de la capacité de haut niveau au niveau régional et coordonner la surveillance locale de la capacité. Développement des talents et coordination des politiques des marques : Être le point de contact entre les maisons et la région / les marchés / ateliers de bijoux afin de consolider les besoins en accord avec la stratégie. Garantir une connaissance complète du produit (y compris les nouveautés). Rassemblez les besoins de formation et mettez en place des parcours structurés pour tous les bijoutiers (y compris les débutants). Coordonnez les chefs d’équipe pour qu’ils : évaluent les compétences des bijoutiers pendant le processus de recrutement. Gérer le parcours professionnel et le développement des bijoutiers au sein de la région. Assurez une mise en œuvre cohérente et le respect des politiques de Maisons, gérez de manière proactive leurs mises à jour et ajustements. Soutien technique et excellence opérationnelle : Servir de principal point de contact technique pour les Maisons de la région (y compris les conseils techniques sur les processus de réparation), en assurant la liaison avec les responsables d’équipe des ateliers de bijouterie lorsque cela est approprié. Superviser la gestion opérationnelle de tous les outils et équipements. Gestion fonctionnelle de tous les chefs d’équipe des ateliers de bijouterie afin de s’assurer qu’ils : Instaurent et maintiennent des normes rigoureuses de surveillance qualité pour toutes les opérations de bijouterie. Développez, mettez en œuvre et garantissez le respect des procédures de diagnostic, de réparation et opérationnelles. Gérer l’organisation des ateliers (plateforme et boutique) conformément aux normes régionales. Proposez des ajustements de disposition d’atelier pour de nouvelles créations de boutique ou des modifications de plateforme. Répondez aux questions techniques des boutiques et fournissez un support technique essentiel aux équipes de contact client. Gestion de la sous-traitance externe (en étroite collaboration avec le directeur du réseau externe européen) : Assurer/gérer la qualité et les délais de livraison des sous-traitants Coordonner le partage de la documentation technique et des formations associées. Gérer l’évaluation et la coordination administrative des tests de laboratoire des (nouveaux) partenaires jusqu’à la gestion des contrats. Organiser et faciliter les échanges et visites du réseau. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Nous recherchons une personne hautement organisée et attentive aux détails, avec un fort esprit collaboratif et un fort intérêt pour le secteur des bijoux de luxe. Vous avez une expérience en opérations de bijouterie, services techniques ou un domaine connexe, idéalement dans un environnement de luxe. Vous faites preuve d’excellentes compétences en coordination, communication et relations interpersonnelles, permettant une collaboration efficace avec des parties prenantes diverses sur plusieurs sites de réparation et maisons européens. Vous avez une expérience avérée dans la gestion des budgets, le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance et l’amélioration des performances. Vous êtes compétent pour fournir une expertise technique, élaborer des procédures opérationnelles et garantir des normes de qualité. L’expérience en formation, transfert de connaissances et coordination de projets est très valorisée. Vous parlez couramment anglais ; la maîtrise du français ou d’autres langues européennes est un atout important. Vous êtes proactif, autonome et capable de mener des initiatives de la conception à la réalisation. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois similaires Responsable régional de la bijouterie Save Dubaï, Émirats arabes unis Richemont Europe Contrôleur FP&A Save Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Responsable de projet services clients Europe-CIS Save Genève, Suisse Van Cleef & Arpels

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR127630 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: The mission consists in leveraging best-in-class processes, organization, technology & Master Data Management implementation and supporting efficient end-to-end operational solutions across Functions, Maisons, and Regions for Compliance effectiveness while decreasing the most possible constraints on impacted processes and organization. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Ensure support and consulting service for our internal stakeholders’ community on Product & Trade Compliance data management and processes. Punctually train junior profile in the Group. Analyse support demand for Product & Trade Compliance implementation solution concerning system and data under our process ownership and conduct the appropriate enhancement or initiative framing to deliver effective & efficient solution. Contribute to Logistics & Compliance Master Data management that are under our central responsibility. Maintain the group logistic & compliance data guideline documentation for continuous improvement. Contribute to the data quality & data stewardship for data contributed by our stakeholders (Maisons, Group, Region) that are under our responsibility and covered by our Master Data Governance. Lead some root cause analyze, continuous MDM & compliance process improvements initiative Support in projects that require our PTC data management & process expertise. Job’s main interactions with:
• Group Product & Trade Compliance Central & Regional Regulatory Experts In close relation with Product & Trade Compliance Regulatory Experts to deeply understand Compliance business requirements, their business impacts, and contribute to identify the best MDM & process solutions for compliance effectiveness implementation.
• Maisons MDM Key support for Maison MDM Experts You’ll be regularly exchanging with Maison MDM to seek additional details as much as guiding them through our PTC MDM expectation (data stewardship, monitor data quality, train, answer questions). You’ll collaborate to understand their operational requirements and coordinate the corresponding system solution.
• Other Group Function Operations stakeholders Collaborate with BPOs and Project Managers as PTC Process & Data SME to contribute to the permanent Group Operations Excellence, enhancements and transformation.
• Group Product Owners & Group Tech stakeholders In close collaboration with GPO, Group Tech L2 & L3, Support HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? At least 3 years’ experience in an international environment in the field of Compliance and & or digital transformation mission, or any role with data & system management involvement. Comfortable with Supply Chain & regulatory domain area (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory documentation & policies interpretation, International Logistics Operational flows,..) Experience in Business Analysis or Project Management a plus Meticulous and very detailed-oriented Comfortable with Digital & IT systems logic and software user interface (good understanding of SAP a plus). General proficiency with Excel (keyboard shortcuts, data manipulation & transformation, export, filters, Xlookup, pivot table, etc.) A kind, consultative and cooperative way of interacting. Interested in the logistics & supply chain world. A proactive mindset in challenging the status quo and supporting continuous pragmatic improvement initiatives Fluent in French, Full Proficient in English due the daily interaction with multi-cultural stakeholders. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity, - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity, - We care for the world we live in. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Vendor Master Data Specialist Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Trade Compliance Expert Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Regional Logistics Senior Project Manager Save Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China Richemont

jobs.title: Chef de Projets Services Techniques
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR127719 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Rattaché au Responsable Services Techniques, vous pilotez des projets d’intégration de nouvelles solutions techniques pour améliorer la performance des machines et des infrastructures du bâtiment. Vous mettez également en place des équipements visant à améliorer la Santé, la Sécurité au Travail et la protection de l'Environnement (SSTE). COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ?
• Piloter des projets d'amélioration et d’intégration de solutions techniques (bâtiment, machines, mobilier et infrastructure…), de réduction des risques SST et de l’impact Environnemental.
• Coordonner les différentes phases des projets, de l'étude de faisabilité à la mise en oeuvre et à la réception.
• Sélectionner et gérer les prestataires internes et externes.
• Assurer le suivi les travaux, le respect des délais et des budgets alloués.

jobs.title: Financial Analytics Engineer - 18 months
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR127766 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT Within the Finance Process & Data team, this temporary position supports a key transformation milestone: the migration of Finance reporting from Power BI to the Looker platform. This role is fully focused on enabling scalable and reliable Finance dashboards by industrializing the data layer in BigQuery and delivering Looker semantic models aligned with governance standards. As a Financial Analytics Engineer, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of Power BI report migrations to Looker. You will build and maintain the Finance data transformation layer in dbt/BigQuery, develop Looker models in LookML, and design Explores to ensure consistent, reusable, and governed analytics for Finance stakeholders. Your mains missions will be: BigQuery + Looker – Data & Semantic Layer for Finance Reporting Build and maintain the Finance transformation layer in dbt/BigQuery to support migrated reporting use cases. Implement robust and scalable transformations aligned with agreed KPI definitions and Finance reporting needs. Develop and maintain Looker semantic models (LookML): views, models, joins, dimensions/measures. Create and optimize Explores to enable consistent self‑service analysis and provide reusable foundations for dashboards. Migration Delivery – Power BI Decommissioning & Looker Adoption Translate existing Power BI logic into governed Looker/BigQuery equivalents (metrics, filters, drill paths). Execute the migration through structured waves, ensuring delivery tracking and alignment with the decommissioning roadmap. Ensure smooth handover: documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer to internal teams. Governance, Standards & Documentation Apply agreed development standards (naming conventions, documentation and testing approach) across dbt and Looker assets. Ensure data quality controls and long‑term maintainability of the delivered models. Maintain clear documentation of datasets, models and Explores to support ownership and auditability. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR You have a strong hands‑on experience in analytics engineering / BI engineering, ideally in a Finance context. You prossesss have proven expertise in in dbt and SQL, with experience on BigQuery. You possess a proven experience developing on Looker with LookML. You have experience migrating reporting stacks (e.g., Power BI → Looker or similar) is a strong asset. You are delivery‑driven, structured, and reliable, able to execute in a time‑critical transformation context. You have strong attention to data quality, consistency, and documentation. You are a clear communicator, able to work with Finance stakeholders to translate reporting needs into robust models. You are fluent in English, French is a plus. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to explain further steps and discuss the opportunity. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the Hiring Manager. Take your next step with Cartier, we look forward to hearing from you! descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR127766 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. A Cartier, farai parte di una comunità legata da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo prosperano. Potenziamo i singoli talenti, uniti da un impegno condiviso per l'eccellenza, ispirato alle diverse culture del mondo, per rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico. Crediamo che diverse prospettive alimentano l'innovazione e ci spingono a creare esperienze eccezionali.
• Offriamo un ambiente energizzante per la crescita della carriera e l'opportunità di contribuire la vostra visione individuale a un'eredità di creatività. Celebriamo ogni risultato, grande o piccolo, promuovendo connessioni significative attraverso la gratitudine e il sostegno reciproco, alimentando un senso di appartenenza. Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un posto come nessun altro, per sempre andare avanti. HOW WILL You MAKE AN IMPACT All'interno del team Finance Process & Data, questa posizione temporanea supporta una pietra miliare di trasformazione chiave: la migrazione di Finance reporting da Power BI alla piattaforma Looker. Questo ruolo è pienamente focalizzato sulla possibilità di dashboard di finanza scalabili e affidabili industrializzando lo strato di dati in BigQuery e fornendo modelli semantici Looker allineati con gli standard di governance. In qualità di ingegnere di analisi finanziaria, sarai responsabile della consegna end-to-end delle migrazioni di report Power BI a Looker. Costruirete e manterrete lo strato di trasformazione dei dati Finance in dbt/BigQuery, svilupperete modelli Looker in LookML, e il design Esplora per garantire analisi coerenti, riutilizzabili e regolamentate per gli stakeholder Finance. Le vostre missioni principali saranno: BigQuery + Looker – Data & Semantic Layer for Finance Reporting Build e mantenere lo strato di trasformazione Finance in dbt/BigQuery per supportare i casi di utilizzo di report migrati. Implementare trasformazioni robuste e scalabili allineate alle definizioni KPI concordate e alle esigenze di reporting Finance. Sviluppare e mantenere Looker modelli semantici (LookML): visualizzazioni, modelli, uni, dimensioni / misure. Creare e ottimizzare Esplora per consentire un'analisi self-service coerente e fornire basi riutilizzabili per dashboard. Consegna delle migrazioni – Power BI Decommissioning & Looker Adoption Traduci la logica BI esistente in equivalenti Looker/BigQuery governati (metri, filtri, percorsi di perforazione). Eseguire la migrazione attraverso onde strutturate, assicurando il tracciamento delle consegne e l'allineamento con la roadmap dismessa. Assicurare un passaggio agevole: documentazione, runbook e trasferimento di conoscenze alle squadre interne. Governance, Standards & Documentation Applicare gli standard di sviluppo concordati (convenzioni di denominazione, documentazione e approccio di test) su beni dbt e Looker. Assicurare i controlli di qualità dei dati e la manutenzione a lungo termine dei modelli consegnati. Mantenere chiara documentazione di dataset, modelli e esplora per supportare la proprietà e l'auditability. Che cosa stiamo cercando Hai una forte esperienza pratica nell'ingegneria di analisi / ingegneria BI, idealmente in un contesto finanziario. Voi prossess avete dimostrato esperienza in dbt e SQL, con esperienza su BigQuery. Possiedi un'esperienza comprovata che si sviluppa su Looker con LookML. Hai esperienza nella migrazione di stack di report (ad esempio, Power BI → Looker o simili) è un bene forte. Siete orientati alla consegna, strutturati e affidabili, in grado di eseguire in un contesto di trasformazione temporale-critica. Hai una forte attenzione alla qualità dei dati, alla coerenza e alla documentazione. Sei un comunicatore chiaro, in grado di lavorare con gli stakeholder Finance per tradurre le esigenze di reportistica in modelli robusti. Sei fluente in inglese, il francese è un vantaggio. TUA GIORNATA CON NOI Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, vi daremo una chiamata introduttiva per spiegare ulteriori passi e discutere l'opportunità. Se le cose vanno bene su entrambe le estremità, si avrà la possibilità di incontrare il Gestore di Assunzioni. Fai il tuo prossimo passo con Cartier, non vediamo l'ora di sentire da te!
