descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Codice di riferimento: JR128518 Nel mondo della casa, i nostri dipendenti di tutte le passeggiate della vita condividono con passione un obiettivo comune: la ricerca permanente di eccellenza portata avanti dalle eccezionali competenze e impegno delle donne e degli uomini che lavorano nella nostra Manifattura. Una casa di intenditori in Alta Orologeria, Vacheron Constantin non ha mai cessato, durante i suoi oltre 269 anni di storia, di creare, arricchire e reinventarsi. Essere uno di non molti per il THOSE e di quelli che cercano l'ESCELLENCE Unisciti a una delle case iconiche di alta orologeria, dove l'eccellenza è un requisito costante. Partecipa al nostro successo collettivo e alla creazione del nostro futuro patrimonio. La tua ragione di essere nella casa Stiamo cercando un Leader Performance Decolletage (H/F). Attaccato al Manager of Manufacturing, sarai responsabile della guida e della facilitazione dell'approccio prestazionale del settore blasting, contribuendo all'eccellenza dei processi e supportando i team di produzione, dalla diagnosi all'implementazione delle soluzioni e al raggiungimento dei risultati. IL TUO RUOLO DI PIÙ 1. Impulsione e animare il processo di miglioramento delle prestazioni: - Gestione della raccolta e dell'analisi dei dati, accompagnando i team nell'evoluzione delle pratiche. - Costruire e seguire dashboard analitici per identificare le leve di ottimizzazione. - Progetti pilota di ottimizzazione mirati con team operativi e di supporto. - Attuazione di strumenti di gestione visiva per monitorare le prestazioni e animare le routine. 2. Contribuire a Process Excellence: - Supportare i team di produzione in diversi approcci di affidabilità di processo. - Condurre la diagnostica per identificare le aree prioritarie di lavoro. - Incoraggia l'implementazione di processi di taglio incrociato con tutti i servizi di supporto. - Formalizzare e ottimizzare gli standard operativi e supportare la digitalizzazione delle informazioni. 3. Sostenere il team di produzione: - Lavorare in collaborazione con il responsabile del workshop e i regolatori per garantire la comprensione e la sostenibilità di tutte le azioni implementate. - No. Integrare l'ambiente di produzione per fornire una prospettiva esterna e garantire la pertinenza delle iniziative. QUALITÀ PER ESCLUSIONE Il successo in questo ruolo dipende da: - La vostra formazione di ingegneria in ingegneria industriale, meccanica, microtecnica o equivalente - La vostra esperienza di almeno 5 anni in un ambiente industriale esigente (in modo manuale, microtecnica, medico..) - La vostra motivazione a lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro dinamico all'interno della produzione - Le vostre eccellenti capacità di comunicazione - Le vostre soluzioni di orientamento e risultati - La vostra facilità con: project management, strumenti Lean (TRS, Kaizen, SPC), la suite Office e PowerBI/GCP Vacheron Constantin ha festeggiato il suo 270 ° anniversario come la più antica fabbrica orologiera al mondo, in funzionamento continuo dal 1755. Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, la nostra Casa gestisce una rete globale di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità – orologiai, artigiani e professionisti – condivide la stessa passione per la nostra eredità e l'ambizione di costruire un futuro ancora più luminoso. Pronto a far parte della nostra storia? Saremo lieti di scoprire la vostra applicazione. In the world of the House, our employees from all walks of life share with passion a common goal: the constant quest for excellence brought about by the exceptional skills and commitment of the women and men who work in our Manufacture. A house of connoisseurs in Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin has never ceased, during his more than 269 years of history, to create, enrich and reinvent himself. Be One Of Not Many FOR THOSE AND THOSE WHO RESEARCH EXCELLENCE Join one of the iconic houses of high watchmaking, where excellence is a constant requirement. Take part in our collective success and the creation of our future heritage. YOUR REASON TO BE IN THE HOUSE We are looking for a Leader Performance Decolletage (H/F). Attached to the Manager of Manufacturing, you will have the responsibility to drive and animate the performance approach of the peeling sector, to contribute to the excellence of the processes and to accompany the production teams, from the diagnosis to the implementation of the solutions and the achievement of the results. YOUR ROLE TO PLAY You will be in charge of:
1. To drive and drive the process of improving performance:
- Manage data collection and analysis, supporting teams in the evolution of practices.
- Build and track analytical dashboards to identify optimization levers.
- Pilot targeted optimization projects with operational and support teams.
- Implement visual management tools to monitor performance and animate routines.
2. Contribute to Process Excellence:
- Support production teams in various process reliability procedures.
- Make diagnostics to identify priority areas of work.
- Encourage the implementation of cross-cutting processes with all support services.
- Formalize and optimize operational standards, and support the digitization of information.
3. Support the production team:
- Work in partnership with the workshop manager and regulators to ensure the understanding and sustainability of all actions implemented.
- To integrate into the production environment to provide an external perspective and ensure the relevance of initiatives.
QUALITIES FOR EXCELLING Success in this role depends on:
- Your engineering training in industrial, mechanical, microtechnical or equivalent engineering
- Your experience of at least 5 years in a demanding industrial environment (ideally watchmaking, microtechnical, medical..)
- Your motivation to work in a dynamic working environment within production
- Your excellent communication skills
- Your orientation solutions and results
- Your convenience with: project management, Lean tools (TRS, Kaizen, SPC), Office Suite and PowerBI/GCP
Vacheron Constantin celebrated 270 years as the oldest watchmaking factory in the world, in continuous operation since 1755. Based in Geneva, Switzerland, our House operates a worldwide network of nearly 200 outlets in 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional community – watchmakers, artisans and professionals – shares the same passion for our heritage and ambition to build an even brighter future. Ready to be part of our story? We will be delighted to discover your application.

Referenzcode: JR128518

- Ihre Erfahrung von mindestens 5 Jahren in einem anspruchsvollen industriellen Umfeld (ideal Uhren, mikrotechnisch, medizinisch.)
- Ihre Motivation, in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld in der Produktion zu arbeiten
- Ihre exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Ihre Orientierungslösungen und Ergebnisse

## Descrizione
Reference code: JR128518
Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos collaborateurs de tous horizons partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement exceptionnels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de connaisseurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Be One Of Not Many POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Nous recherchons un Leader Performance Decolletage (H/F). Rattaché(e) au Responsable du Manufacturing, vous aurez la responsabilité d'impulser et d’animer la démarche de performance du secteur décolletage, de contribuer à l'excellence des processus et d'accompagner les équipes de production, depuis le diagnostic jusqu'à l'implémentation des solutions et l'atteinte des résultats. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Vous serez en charge de :
1. Impulser et animer la démarche d’amélioration de la performance :
- Gérer la collecte et l'analyse des données, en accompagnant les équipes dans l'évolution des pratiques.
- Construire et suivre des tableaux de bord d'analyse pour identifier les leviers d'optimisation.
- Piloter des projets d'optimisation ciblés avec les équipes opérationnelles et support.
- Mettre en place des outils de management visuel pour le suivi de la performance et animer les routines.
2. Contribuer à l’excellence des Processus :
- Soutenir les équipes production dans les différentes démarches de fiabilité process.
- Réaliser des diagnostics pour identifier les axes de travail prioritaires.
- Animer la mise en place de processus transverses avec l’ensemble des services supports.
- Formaliser et optimiser les standards opérationnels, et soutenir la digitalisation des informations.
3. Accompagner l’équipe production :
- Travailler en partenariat avec le responsable d’atelier et les régleurs pour assurer la compréhension et la pérennité de l’ensemble des actions mises en place.
- S’intégrer à l’environnement de production pour apporter un regard extérieur et assurer la pertinence des initiatives.
LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur :
- Votre formation d’ingénieur en génie industriel, mécanique, microtechnique ou équivalent
- Votre expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans un environnement industriel exigeant (idéalement horlogerie, microtechnique, médical..)
- Votre motivation à travailler dans un environnement de travail dynamique au sein de la production
- Vos excellentes capacités de communication
- Votre orientation solutions et résultats
- Votre aisance avec : la gestion de projet, les outils Lean (TRS, Kaizen, SPC), la suite Office et PowerBI/GCP
Vacheron Constantin a célébré ses 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature.

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128519 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Avec pour mission de piloter et animer des projets qualité au sein de la Manufacture et d’assurer le déploiement et l’ancrage des solutions avec les équipes. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Intégré à l’équipe, vous traiterez des sujets opérationnels tels que les contrôles efficients et les analyses qualités. Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous serez en charge des tâches suivantes : Gestion de projets qualité : Définir les projets : contexte, objectif, périmètre, budget et planning. Assurer la communication entre tous les acteurs des projets. Suivre et s’assurer de l’efficacité des plans d’actions qualités inhérents aux projets. Définition et amélioration des standards de contrôle : Cartographier l’ensemble des flux de fabrication et des moyens de contrôle associés. Définir et formaliser les critères d’acceptation qualité : instructions, plans de surveillance, etc. Piloter le plan de déploiement : actions correctives et préventives, audit de conformité. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Vous êtes étudiant en école d’ingénieur avec si possible une orientation dans la qualité. Vous êtes une personne autonome, proactive, organisée et rigoureuse, possédant de fortes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse, de communication et sachant gérer les priorités. Vous disposez d’une forte orientation terrain et d’une appétence pour la gestion de projets et la qualité. Vous avez de solides connaissances des outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez des connaissances sur les méthodes et outils qualité (capabilités process, moyens de mesure, R&R, statistiques, échantillonnage, 8D, QRQC, …). Vos connaissances des outils du Lean Manufacturing sont un atout supplémentaire. Vous avez une première expérience projet, qualité ou production dans un secteur industriel, un plus. QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Nous vous proposons d’évoluer dans un environnement de travail stimulant, combinant l'héritage historique du savoir-faire de l'horlogerie de luxe avec les technologies de pointe de l'industrie 4.0. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation approfondie tout au long de votre stage (métier & gestion de projet), ainsi que d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour atteindre vos objectifs professionnels. Nous sommes convaincus que l'autonomie est un élément clé pour la réussite professionnelle, c'est pourquoi nous offrons un environnement de travail qui vous permettra d'être pleinement responsable dans votre travail. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature complète sur notre site de carrières. Si vous correspondez au profil recherché, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique avec notre équipe RH afin de convenir d’un entretien. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Stagiaire Chargé de Projets Process Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier Stagiaire Amélioration Continue Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier Chargé de Projets SSTE Save Buttes, Switzerland ValFleurier

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de projet du patrimoine (couverture maternelle)

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128553 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Heritage Project Manager, you will be responsible for the preservation, management, and promotion of Piaget's private collection. This includes historical timepieces, documents, designs, and other artifacts that represent the brand's rich heritage. The role encompasses collection management, exhibition development, documentation, authentication support, and contributing to the overall heritage strategy of Piaget. Key responsibilities: Piaget Private Collection Management: Manage the inventory, cataloguing, storage, and restoration of the Piaget private collection. Oversee strategic acquisitions for the collection, aligning with heritage strategy and monitoring auctions. Create and maintain a comprehensive database for all collection items, including descriptions, provenance, images, and condition reports. Promote the Piaget heritage collection through online platforms, social media, and public events. Exhibition Development: Plan, develop, and execute engaging heritage exhibitions for the Piaget Retail Network and external venues. Collaborate with curators and designers to create compelling exhibition narratives and displays. Manage all exhibition logistics, including transportation, installation, and de-installation of collection items. Knowledge Transmission & Heritage Strategy: Contribute to educational materials and publications related to Piaget heritage. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Piaget's history, production techniques, and design evolution. Play a key role in the development and implementation of Piaget's overall heritage strategy. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in History, Art History, Museum Studies, or a closely related field. Professional Experience: Proven experience in heritage management, museum curation, or auction houses, with a strong preference for candidates from the luxury goods industry. Specialized Expertise: In-depth knowledge of horology, the history of watchmaking, and robust understanding of collection management principles and best practices. Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience in exhibition development and comprehensive project management. Communication & Language: Exceptional research, writing, and communication skills, coupled with fluency in both English and French (written and spoken). Technical Proficiency: Proficient in database management and digital asset management systems. Interpersonal Attributes: An agile, flexible team player, adept at fostering relationships within a multinational and culturally diverse environment. Possesses a high level of ethics, strong values, and an unwavering commitment to confidentiality. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR128553 Circondato dalla sua famiglia e guidato dalla sua forte mentalità imprenditoriale, Georges-Edouard Piaget decise, nel 1874, di creare un'officina orologiera a La Côte-aux-Fées, un piccolo villaggio al centro delle montagne svizzere della Giura. Da quel giorno, Piaget ha spinto i limiti a “fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima” e artigianale orologi sofisticati e fiammeggianti e creazioni di gioielli. All’interno delle mura dei nostri Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, i nostri maestri artigiani continuano a sfruttare rare abilità che sono state conservate e perfezionate di generazione in generazione. Oggi, l’eccezionale maestria di Piaget è celebrata in tutto il mondo, sostenuta da una forte presenza globale e da una rete dedicata di supporto clienti e colleghi retail che portano lo spirito della nostra Maison alla vita ogni giorno. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Come responsabile del progetto Heritage, sarai responsabile della conservazione, della gestione e della promozione della collezione privata di Piaget. Questo include orologi storici, documenti, disegni e altri manufatti che rappresentano il ricco patrimonio del marchio. Il ruolo comprende la gestione delle collezioni, lo sviluppo delle mostre, la documentazione, il supporto per l'autenticazione e il contributo alla strategia globale del patrimonio di Piaget. descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR128553 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Heritage Project Manager, you will be responsible for the preservation, management, and promotion of Piaget's private collection. This includes historical timepieces, documents, designs, and other artifacts that represent the brand's rich heritage. The role encompasses collection management, exhibition development, documentation, authentication support, and contributing to the overall heritage strategy of Piaget. Key responsibilities: Piaget Private Collection Management: Manage the inventory, cataloguing, storage, and restoration of the Piaget private collection. Oversee strategic acquisitions for the collection, aligning with heritage strategy and monitoring auctions. Create and maintain a comprehensive database for all collection items, including descriptions, provenance, images, and condition reports. Promote the Piaget heritage collection through online platforms, social media, and public events. Exhibition Development: Plan, develop, and execute engaging heritage exhibitions for the Piaget Retail Network and external venues. Collaborate with curators and designers to create compelling exhibition narratives and displays. Manage all exhibition logistics, including transportation, installation, and de-installation of collection items. Knowledge Transmission & Heritage Strategy: Contribute to educational materials and publications related to Piaget heritage. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Piaget's history, production techniques, and design evolution. Play a key role in the development and implementation of Piaget's overall heritage strategy. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in History, Art History, Museum Studies, or a closely related field. Professional Experience: Proven experience in heritage management, museum curation, or auction houses, with a strong preference for candidates from the luxury goods industry. Specialized Expertise: In-depth knowledge of horology, the history of watchmaking, and robust understanding of collection management principles and best practices. Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience in exhibition development and comprehensive project management. Communication & Language: Exceptional research, writing, and communication skills, coupled with fluency in both English and French (written and spoken). Technical Proficiency: Proficient in database management and digital asset management systems. Interpersonal Attributes: An agile, flexible team player, adept at fostering relationships within a multinational and culturally diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.de: Referenzcode: JR128553 Umgeben von seiner Familie und geleitet von seinem starken Unternehmergeist entschied Georges-Edouard Piaget 1874, eine Uhrwerkstatt in La Côte-aux-Fées zu schaffen, ein kleines Dorf inmitten der Schweizer Berge des Jura. Seit diesem Tag hat Piaget die Grenzen geschoben, um „das zu tun, was noch nie getan wurde“ und Handwerk anspruchsvolle und flamboyante Uhren und Schmuck Kreationen. In den Mauern unseres Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire setzen unsere Handwerker weiterhin seltene Fähigkeiten ein, die von Generation zu Generation erhalten und perfektioniert wurden. Heute wird die außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst von Piaget weltweit gefeiert, unterstützt von einer starken globalen Präsenz und einem engagierten Netzwerk von Kunden-Support- und Einzelhandelskollegen, die den Geist unseres Hauses jeden Tag zum Leben bringen. Wie wär's, wenn du einen IMPACT machst? Als Heritage Project Manager sind Sie für die Erhaltung, Verwaltung und Förderung der privaten Sammlung von Piaget verantwortlich. Dazu gehören historische Zeitmesser, Dokumente, Designs und andere Artefakte, die das reiche Erbe der Marke darstellen. Die Rolle umfasst Sammlungsmanagement, Ausstellungsentwicklung, Dokumentation, Authentifizierungsunterstützung und einen Beitrag zur Gesamtkulturstrategie von Piaget. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten: Piaget Private Collection Management: Verwalten Sie das Inventar, Katalogisierung, Lagerung und Restauration der Piaget Private Collection. Besuchen Sie strategische Akquisitionen für die Sammlung, die Ausrichtung auf die Kulturstrategie und die Überwachung von Auktionen. Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine umfassende Datenbank für alle Sammlungsgegenstände, einschließlich Beschreibungen, Provenienz, Bilder und Zustandsberichte. Fördern Sie die Piaget-Erbesammlung durch Online-Plattformen, Social Media und öffentliche Veranstaltungen. Ausstellungsentwicklung: Planen, entwickeln und führen spannende Ausstellungen für das Piaget Retail Network und externe Veranstaltungsorte durch. Mit Kuratoren und Designern zusammenarbeiten, um spannende Ausstellungserzählungen und Präsentationen zu erstellen. Verwalten Sie alle Ausstellungslogistik, einschließlich Transport, Installation und Deinstallation von Sammlungsgegenständen. Wissensübertragung & Kulturerbe Strategie: Beitrag zu Bildungsmaterialien und Publikationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Erbe Piaget. Bewahren Sie umfassende Kenntnisse über Piagets Geschichte, Produktionstechniken und Designentwicklung. Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Piagets Gesamterbestrategie. Worauf wollen Sie mit uns? Spezialisierte Expertise: Vertieftes Wissen über die Horologie, die Geschichte der Uhrmacherei und das robuste Verständnis der Prinzipien des Sammelmanagements und der besten Praktiken. Projektleitung: Demonstrierte Erfahrung in der Ausstellungsentwicklung und umfassendes Projektmanagement. Kommunikation & Sprache: Außergewöhnliche Forschung, Schreiben und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, verbunden mit fließenden in Englisch und Französisch (schriftlich und gesprochen). Technische Kompetenz: Proficient in Datenbankmanagement und digitalen Asset Management Systemen. Interpersonal Attributes: Ein agiler, flexibler Teamplayer, der die Beziehungen innerhalb einer multinationalen und kulturell vielfältigen Umgebung förderte. Besteht ein hohes Maß an Ethik, starken Werten und ein unerschütterliches Engagement für Vertraulichkeit. Was willst du tun? Ein kommendes Team: Melden Sie sich an unserem freundlichen, offenen und talentierten Team, wo Ihre Fähigkeiten geschätzt werden und Ihre Beiträge einen echten Unterschied machen. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Erleben Sie tägliche Aktivitäten, die interessant, herausfordernd und vielfältig sind und Sie engagiert und motiviert halten. Investitionen in Ihr Wachstum: Wir sind leidenschaftlich über die Entwicklung unserer Menschen, und Sie haben Zugang zu verschiedenen Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere voranzubringen. Die Piaget-Kultur, Extra-Care zu fördern, Meisterschaft zu fördern und das Außerordentliche in unserem Volk herauszubringen, bedeutet, dass wir immer weiter gehen werden, indem wir „was noch nie zuvor getan wurde“. Zusammen. Wenn Sie ein Teil davon werden möchten, zögern Sie nicht zu bewerben! descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR128553 Entouré de sa famille et guidé par son esprit d'entreprise fort, Georges-Edouard Piaget décide, en 1874, de créer un atelier d'horlogerie à La Côte-aux-Fées, petit village au milieu des montagnes suisses du Jura. Depuis ce jour, Piaget a poussé les limites à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant. Dans les murs de nos Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire, nos maîtres artisans continuent d'exploiter des compétences rares qui ont été préservées et perfectionnées de génération en génération. Aujourd'hui, l'artisanat exceptionnel de Piaget est célébré dans le monde entier, soutenu par une forte présence mondiale et un réseau dédié de clients et de collègues de vente au détail qui animent chaque jour l'esprit de notre Maison. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? En tant que gestionnaire de projet patrimonial, vous serez responsable de la conservation, de la gestion et de la promotion de la collection privée de Piaget. Cela comprend des montres historiques, des documents, des dessins et autres artefacts qui représentent le riche patrimoine de la marque. Ce rôle englobe la gestion des collections, le développement des expositions, la documentation, le soutien à l'authentification et la contribution à la stratégie patrimoniale globale de Piaget. Principales responsabilités : Piaget Private Collection Management : Gérer l'inventaire, le catalogage, le stockage et la restauration de la collection privée Piaget. Superviser les acquisitions stratégiques pour la collection, s'aligner sur la stratégie patrimoniale et surveiller les enchères. Créer et tenir à jour une base de données complète pour tous les éléments de la collection, y compris les descriptions, la provenance, les images et les rapports d'état. Promouvoir la collection du patrimoine Piaget au moyen de plateformes en ligne, de médias sociaux et d'événements publics. Développement de l'exposition : Planifiez, développez et exécutez des expositions patrimoniales pour le réseau Piaget Retail et des lieux externes. Collaborer avec les conservateurs et les concepteurs pour créer des récits et des expositions fascinants. Gérer toute la logistique d'exposition, y compris le transport, l'installation et la désinstallation des objets de collection. Stratégie de transmission des connaissances et du patrimoine : Contribuer au matériel éducatif et aux publications liées au patrimoine Piaget. Maintenir une connaissance complète de l'histoire, des techniques de production et de l'évolution de la conception de Piaget. Jouer un rôle clé dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie patrimoniale globale de Piaget. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Études : Licence ou maîtrise en histoire, histoire de l'art, études muséales ou domaine étroitement lié. Expérience professionnelle : Expérience éprouvée en gestion du patrimoine, en gestion de musée ou en vente aux enchères, avec une forte préférence pour les candidats de l'industrie des produits de luxe. Expertise spécialisée : Connaissance approfondie de l'horologie, de l'histoire de l'horlogerie et compréhension solide des principes de gestion de la collection et des meilleures pratiques. Leadership du projet : Expérience démontrée dans le développement d'expositions et la gestion complète du projet. Communication et langue : Compétences exceptionnelles en recherche, écriture et communication, associées à la maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé). Compétences techniques : Connaissance des systèmes de gestion des bases de données et des actifs numériques. Attributs interpersonnels : Un joueur agile et flexible, capable de favoriser les relations dans un environnement multinational et culturel diversifié. Investir dans votre croissance : Nous sommes passionnés par le développement de notre personnel, et vous aurez accès à diverses possibilités de formation et de perfectionnement pour améliorer vos compétences et faire progresser votre carrière. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128572 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. "Our mission is to turn complex cloud and DevOps capabilities into simple, self-service experiences that let teams innovate faster and safer" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) ABOUT THE ROLE As a DevOps Services Engineering Intern at Richemont, you will contribute to the evolution of our Internal Developer Portal (IDP) by building components, service interfaces, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to easily consume automated cloud and DevOps services. This is a hands-on internship designed for enthusiastic learners who want to develop strong foundations in Cloud, DevOps, and automation, while contributing to meaningfull initiatives used by real client teams. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help streamline workflows, improve deployment practices, and enhance developer self-service capabilities using modern DevOps and cloud technologies. WHAT YOU WILL DO During your internship, you will: Assist in building and improving CI/CD pipelines supporting portal and service delivery Write and maintain scripts or services to support automation and integrations Collaborate with development teams to automate workflows and deployment processes Contribute to the creation of packaged, reusable automated services exposed through the portal Work with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Gain exposure to Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP, Alicloud) Proactively identify gaps, suggest improvements, and contribute ideas to enhance developer experience Document processes, tools, and best practices for internal use. Apply DevOps best practices to ensure reliability, consistency, and transparency Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Platform, and Cloud Governance & Architecture teams to optimize configuration and enhance deployment efficiency, governance & security Stay up to date with emerging Cloud and DevOps technologies WHO YOU ARE You are a student or junior engineer who: Is currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field Has hands-on experience with scripting languages Has a strong interest in DevOps, cloud platforms, automation, or platform engineering Is comfortable working with APIs and modern web development concepts Has basic knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, or DevOps practices Has introductory exposure to containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and / or cloud concepts Is curious, proactive, and eager to learn beyond frontend development Communicates clearly and enjoys working in cross-functional teams HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team environment focused on mentoring and personal development, you will participate in our digital transformation journey at Richemont Group. You will be able to work in an enriching and challenging technical environment with cutting-edge technologies. If you are passionate about delivering seamless deployments and client success, driving automation, DevOps practices, and working with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and if you thrive in a dynamic and collaborative work environment, we invite you to join our team ! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Cloud Security Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont DEVOPS Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Cloud Security Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Reference code: JR128572 Richemont possiede alcuni dei principali marchi di lusso al mondo, con particolare attenzione all'orologeria, agli accessori di lusso e alla gioielleria. Ogni marchio rappresenta una tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuno dei suoi marchi. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell'innovazione e nella creazione di nuovi prodotti che rispettino i valori dei nostri marchi attraverso un processo di creatività continua. "La nostra missione è quella di trasformare le complesse capacità cloud e DevOps in esperienze di auto-servizio semplici che consentano alle squadre di innovare più velocemente e in modo più sicuro" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) Come stagista DevOps Services Engineering presso Richemont, contribuirete all'evoluzione del nostro Internal Developer Portal (IDP) costruendo componenti, interfacce di servizio e flussi di lavoro di auto-servizio che consentono alle squadre interne di utilizzare facilmente i servizi cloud e DevOps automatizzati. Si tratta di uno stage pratico progettato per gli entusiasti che vogliono sviluppare solide basi in cloud, DevOps e automazione, mentre contribuiscono a iniziative significative utilizzate da squadre client reali. Durante il tuo stage, ti aspettano:
• Assistere nella costruzione e miglioramento delle pipeline CI/CD che supportano la consegna del portale e dei servizi
• Scrivere e mantenere script o servizi per supportare l'automazione e le integrazioni
• Collaborare con le squadre di sviluppo per automatizzare i flussi di lavoro e i processi di distribuzione
• Contribuire alla creazione di servizi automatizzati, riutilizzabili e confezionati, esposti attraverso il portale
• Lavora con tecnologie container come Docker e Kubernetes
• Esponi alle piattaforme cloud (AWS, GCP, Alicloud)
• Identificare proattivamente le lacune, suggerire miglioramenti e contribuire con idee per migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori
• Documentare processi, strumenti e best practice per uso interno
• Applicare le best practice DevOps per garantire affidabilità, coerenza e trasparenza Collaborare con le squadre di infrastruttura cloud, piattaforma DevOps e governance e architettura cloud per ottimizzare la configurazione e migliorare l'efficienza, la governance e la sicurezza dei deploy Mantenersi aggiornati sulle tecnologie cloud e DevOps emergenti
• Sei uno studente o un giovane ingegnera che:
• Sta attualmente frequentando (o ha recentemente completato) un corso di laurea in Scienze Informatiche, IT o un campo affine
• Ha esperienza pratica con i linguaggi di scripting
• Ha un forte interesse per DevOps, piattaforme cloud, automazione o ingegneria delle piattaforme
• Si sente a proprio agio nel lavorare con le API e i concetti di sviluppo web moderni
• Ha conoscenze basilari delle pipeline CI/CD, dei flussi di lavoro basati su Git o delle pratiche DevOps
• Ha una conoscenza introduttiva dei container (Docker, Kubernetes) e/o dei concetti di cloud
• E curioso, proattivo e desideroso di imparare oltre lo sviluppo frontend
• Comunica chiaramente e gode di lavorare in squadre multifunzionali Come ti teniamo sorridente In un ambiente di squadra giovane e dinamico focalizzato sul mentoring e lo sviluppo personale, parteciperai al nostro viaggio di trasformazione digitale nel gruppo Richemont. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente tecnico arricchente e stimolante con tecnologie all'avanguardia. Se sei appassionato di consegnare deploy senza soluzione di continuità e successo del cliente, guidare l'automazione, le pratiche DevOps e lavorare con tecnologie cloud all'avanguardia, e se ti piace lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo, ti invitiamo a unirti alla nostra squadra!

"Unsere Mission besteht darin, komplexe Cloud- und DevOps-Fähigkeiten in einfache, selbstbediente Erfahrungen zu verwandeln, die es Teams ermöglichen, schneller und sicherer zu innovieren" (Michelle Daalman, - DevOps Services Team) Als Praktikant/in für DevOps Services Engineering bei Richemont tragen Sie zur Evolution unseres Internal Developer Portals (IDP) bei, indem Sie Komponenten, Dienstschnittstellen und selbstbediente Arbeitsabläufe erstellen, die es internen Teams ermöglichen, automatisierte Cloud- und DevOps-Dienste einfach zu nutzen. Dies ist ein praktischer Praktikumsplatz, der für enthusiastische Lernende konzipiert wurde, die starke Grundlagen in Cloud, DevOps und Automatisierung aufbauen möchten und dabei an bedeutenden Initiativen mitwirken, die von realen Kunden-Teams genutzt werden.
• Während Ihres Praktikums werden Sie:
• Bei der Erstellung und Verbesserung von CI/CD-Pipelines mitwirken, die die Portallieferung und den Service unterstützen
• Skripte oder Dienste schreiben und pflegen, um die Automatisierung und Integrationen zu unterstützen
• Mit Entwicklungsteams zusammenarbeiten, um Arbeitsabläufe und Deploy-Prozesse zu automatisieren
• Zum Erstellen von verpackten, wiederverwendbaren automatisierten Diensten beitragen, die über das Portal angeboten werden
• Mit Container-Technologien wie Docker und Kubernetes arbeiten
• Einsatz von Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, GCP, Alicloud)
• Lücken aktiv identifizieren, Verbesserungen vorschlagen und Ideen beitragen, um die Entwicklererfahrung zu verbessern
• Prozesse, Tools und Best Practices für die interne Nutzung dokumentieren
• DevOps-Best Practices anwenden, um Zuverlässigkeit, Konsistenz und Transparenz sicherzustellen Mit den Teams für Cloud-Infrastruktur, DevOps-Plattform und Cloud-Governance & Architektur zusammenarbeiten, um die Konfiguration zu optimieren und die Deploy-Effizienz, Governance und Sicherheit zu verbessern Sich über die neuesten Cloud- und DevOps-Technologien auf dem Laufenden halten
• Sie sind ein Student/in oder junger Ingenieur/in, der/die:
• Momentan (oder kürzlich) ein Studium der Informatik, des IT-Bereichs oder eines verwandten Fachs absolviert
• Praktische Erfahrung mit Skriptsprachen hat
• Ein starkes Interesse an DevOps, Cloud-Plattformen, Automatisierung oder Plattform-Engineering hat
• Sich mit APIs und modernen Web-Entwicklungs-Konzepten wohlfühlt
• Grundkenntnisse über CI/CD-Pipelines, Git-basierte Arbeitsabläufe oder DevOps-Praktiken hat
• Grundkenntnisse über Container (Docker, Kubernetes) und/oder Cloud-Konzepte hat
• Neugierig, proaktiv und begierig darauf ist, über die Frontend-Entwicklung hinaus zu lernen
• Klar kommuniziert und gerne in multifunktionalen Teams arbeitet Wie wir Sie zum Lächeln bringen In einem jungen und dynamischen Teamumfeld, das auf Mentoring und persönliche Entwicklung fokussiert ist, nehmen Sie an unserer digitalen Transformationsreise bei der Richemont Group teil. Sie können in einer bereichernden und herausfordernden technischen Umgebung mit cutting-edge-Technologien arbeiten. Wenn Sie begeistert davon sind, nahtlose Deployments und Kundenerfolg zu liefern, die Automatisierung anzutreiben, DevOps-Praktiken anzuwenden und mit cutting-edge-Cloud-Technologien zu arbeiten, und wenn Sie in einer dynamischen und kollaborativen Arbeitsumgebung aufblühen, laden wir Sie ein, unser Team zu verstärken!

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR128584 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT As an International Rewards Specialist, you will support the function with key compensation, benefits and HR performance related processes and projects. You will also support the Rewards & Performance Managers on daily requirements related to compensation processes, reports, and various projects. In this role you will be exposed to diverse key topics and portfolio of projects within an international scope. Your main missions will be: Support and coordinate rewards-related topics by working closely with the Rewards and HR Performance Managers. Support on salary review and other compensation processes (bonus schemes, long term incentives). Support Rewards projects related (but not limited) to Benefits, Pay transparency, Mobility, Insights & Analytics, as well as Performance Management. Provide benchmarks and analyses related to internal and external trends and competitive positioning. Generate, develop and analyse complex compensation data and analyses on an ad-hoc basis. Coordinate staff costs related activities with the finance department and ensure key data is available for business decision support. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR You have a university degree or equivalent in a relevant field (e.g. Business Studies, HR, Finance). You have 3 to 5 years’ experience in Compensation & Benefits or relevant field, previous experience in a consulting firm is ideal. You possess robust experience in HR & Compensation Systems. You possess strong data management and analytics skills. You are at ease with project management skills. You have strong interpersonal skills and Ability to work autonomously. You are fluent in English. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to explain further steps and discuss the opportunity. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the Hiring Manager. Take your next step with Cartier, we look forward to hearing from you! titleByLocale.fr: Stage en Développement et Apprentissage - Suisse

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128550 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Swiss HR Team currently has an opening for a 6-month internship in the Learning & Development (L&D) department, where you will support Richemont employees to improve their skills throughout their career. You will be part of a team, based at the HQ in Geneva, that will develop programs while adapting the offers to the best training objectives through virtual sessions and in-person classes. You will be responsible for the management, logistics and evaluation of these trainings. Training Coordination: Coordinate with external vendors to schedule and manage training sessions, both online and at our two designated locations, ensuring seamless execution. "Richemont Toastmasters" Community Management: Animate and cultivate the "Richemont Toastmasters" community, implementing strategies to enhance member engagement and participation. Learning Platform Administration: Manage user access and assignments for Speexx and Coursera licenses, optimizing utilization of these learning platforms. Learning Management System (LMS) Administration: Create, manage, and maintain learning events and sessions within the Cornerstone LMS, including registration management and session closure. Provide support to other services for course historization and creation within the system. Logistics Management: Oversee catering arrangements for training sessions, ensuring timely and high-quality service delivery. Training Session Support: Manage participant registration lists, confirm attendance with vendors, and distribute post-training evaluation forms to gather feedback. Stakeholder Communication: Provide effective support to internal and external stakeholders, maintaining clear and timely communication channels to address inquiries and provide updates. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree in an HR related field, Business, Project management or equivalent Experience in any kind of project management activity is an asset Excellent Microsoft Office skills (Excel & PowerPoint) Self-starter, independent, attention to detail, punctual Adaptable and customer service oriented Ability to perform under pressure Positive and a “can-do” attitude Fluent in both English and French Available for a 6-months internship with starting date 01.08.2026 Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group L&D Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Benelux & Nordics Save Amsterdam, Netherlands Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR128550 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti case di lusso al mondo, con particolare attenzione all'orologeria, agli accessori di lusso e alla gioielleria. Ogni casa rappresenta una tradizione di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont cerca di preservare l'eredità e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue case. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che rispettino i valori delle nostre case attraverso un processo di creatività continua. Il team HR svizzero ha attualmente un'apertura per un tirocinio di 6 mesi nel dipartimento di Learning & Development (L&D), in cui supporterai i dipendenti Richemont per migliorare le loro competenze nel corso della loro carriera. Sarai parte di un team, con sede presso la sede di Ginevra, che sviluppa programmi mentre adatta le offerte agli obiettivi di formazione più appropriati attraverso sessioni virtuali e corsi in presenza. Sarai responsabile della gestione, della logistica e della valutazione di questi corsi. Coordinamento della formazione: Coordinare con i fornitori esterni per programmare e gestire le sessioni di formazione, sia online che nei nostri due luoghi designati, garantendo un'esecuzione senza interruzioni. "Richemont Toastmasters" Gestione della comunità: Animare e coltivare la comunità "Richemont Toastmasters", implementando strategie per migliorare l'impegno e la partecipazione dei membri. Amministrazione della piattaforma di apprendimento: Gestire l'accesso degli utenti e le assegnazioni per le licenze Speexx e Coursera, ottimizzando l'utilizzo di queste piattaforme di apprendimento. Amministrazione del sistema di gestione dell'apprendimento (LMS): Creare, gestire e mantenere gli eventi e le sessioni di apprendimento all'interno del Cornerstone LMS, inclusa la gestione della registrazione e la chiusura delle sessioni. Fornire supporto ad altri servizi per la storicizzazione e la creazione dei corsi all'interno del sistema. Gestione della logistica: Sorvegliare gli accordi per il catering per le sessioni di formazione, garantendo la consegna tempestiva e di alta qualità dei servizi. Supporto alle sessioni di formazione: Gestire le liste di registrazione dei partecipanti, confermare la presenza con i fornitori e distribuire i moduli di valutazione post-formazione per raccogliere i feedback. Referenzcode: JR128550 Richemont gehört zu den führenden Luxusgüterhäusern der Welt mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Juwelierwaren, hochwertigen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jedes Haus verkörpert eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont strebt danach, die Tradition und Identität jedes seiner Häuser zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir jedoch innovativ und gestalten neue Produkte, die im Einklang mit den Werten unserer Häuser stehen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Das Schweizer HR-Team hat derzeit eine Stelle für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum im Bereich Learning & Development (L&D) zu besetzen, bei dem Sie Richemont-Mitarbeiter dabei unterstützen, ihre Fähigkeiten im Laufe ihrer Karriere zu verbessern. Sie werden Teil eines Teams sein, das am Hauptsitz in Genf ansässig ist und Programme entwickelt, während es die Angebote an die besten Trainingsziele anpasst, und zwar durch virtuelle Sitzungen und Präsenzveranstaltungen. Sie sind für die Verwaltung, die Logistik und die Bewertung dieser Trainings verantwortlich. Trainingskoordination: Koordinieren Sie mit externen Anbietern, um Trainingsitzungen zu planen und zu verwalten, sowohl online als auch an unseren beiden bezeichneten Standorten, und sorgen Sie für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. "Richemont Toastmasters" Community-Management: Animieren und pflegen Sie die "Richemont Toastmasters"-Community und implementieren Sie Strategien, um die Mitgliedschaft und Teilnahme zu erhöhen. Lernplattform-Administration: Verwalten Sie den Benutzerzugriff und die Zuweisungen für Speexx- und Coursera-Lizenzen und optimieren Sie die Nutzung dieser Lernplattformen. Lernmanagementsystem-Administration (LMS): Erstellen, verwalten und pflegen Sie Lernereignisse und -sitzungen innerhalb des Cornerstone-LMS, einschließlich der Verwaltung der Registrierung und des Sitzungsabschlusses. Stellen Sie Unterstützung für andere Dienste zur Kurshistorisierung und -erstellung innerhalb des Systems bereit. Logistikmanagement: Überwachen Sie die Verpflegungsarrangements für Trainingssitzungen und sorgen Sie für eine zeitgerechte und hochwertige Dienstleistungslieferung. Trainingssitzungsunterstützung: Verwalten Sie die Teilnehmerregistrierungslisten, bestätigen Sie die Anwesenheit bei Anbietern und verteilen Sie die Fragebögen zur Nach-Trainingsevaluation, um Feedback zu sammeln. • Aktuell eingeschrieben in einem Master-Studiengang im Bereich HR, Business, Project Management oder Ähnlichem.

Code de référence : JR128550 Richemont possède certaines des plus grandes maisons de luxe au monde, avec des compétences particulières dans les bijoux, les montres de luxe et les accessoires de luxe. Vous serez responsable de la gestion, de la logistique et de l'évaluation de ces formations. Coordonnation de la formation : Coordonner avec les prestataires externes pour planifier et gérer les sessions de formation, à la fois en ligne et dans nos deux emplacements désignés, en garantissant une exécution sans heurts. "Richemont Toastmasters" Gestion de la communauté : Animer et cultiver la communauté "Richemont Toastmasters", en mettant en place des stratégies pour améliorer l'engagement et la participation des membres. Administration de la plateforme d'apprentissage : Gérer l'accès des utilisateurs et les affectations pour les licences Speexx et Coursera, en optimisant l'utilisation de ces plateformes d'apprentissage. Administration du système de gestion de l'apprentissage (LMS) : Créer, gérer et maintenir les événements et sessions d'apprentissage dans le Cornerstone LMS, y compris la gestion de l'inscription et la clôture des sessions. Fournir un soutien aux autres services pour l'historisation et la création des cours dans le système. Gestion de la logistique : Surveiller les accords de restauration pour les sessions de formation, en garantissant une livraison rapide et de haute qualité des services. Support aux sessions de formation : Gérer les listes d'inscription des participants, confirmer la présence auprès des prestataires et distribuer les formulaires d'évaluation post-formation pour recueillir les commentaires. Communication avec les parties prenantes : Fournir un soutien efficace aux parties prenantes internes et externes, en maintenant des canaux de communication clairs et opportuns pour répondre aux questions et fournir des mises à jour. Pour réussir avec nous :
• Actuellement inscrit en master dans un domaine lié aux RH, au commerce, à la gestion de projet ou équivalent.
• Expérience dans toute activité de gestion de projet est un atout.
• Excellentes compétences en Microsoft Office (Excel & PowerPoint).
• Autonome, attentif aux détails, ponctuel.
• Adaptable et orienté vers le service client.
• Able to perform under pressure.
• Positif et avec une attitude "je peux le faire".
• Fluide en anglais et en français.
• Disponible pour un stage de 6 mois avec une date de début au 01.08.2026.
• Accord de stage obligatoire avec votre école/université. Ce qui rend notre groupe différent : Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, cultures et compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à favoriser le potentiel inexploité.
• Nous valorisons la liberté, la camaraderie, la loyauté et la solidarité.

Dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, nous garantissons toujours une totale transparence et une complète vision d'ensemble, à savoir que vous aurez l'occasion de rencontrer les personnes qui seront cruciales pour votre réussite future dans le rôle.

Le spécialiste de l'administration des RH sera responsable de l'administration des RH pour le marché suisse et Richemont Europe. Le spécialiste de l'administration des RH travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe des RH, l'entreprise et l'équipe de la paie et de l'assurance. Vos principales responsabilités seront : Gérer tous les processus administratifs essentiels des RH pour tout le cycle de vie des employés (contrats, addenda, certificat de travail, etc...) Interagir avec les employés dans les bureaux et les boutiques de Maisons & Richemont en Suisse S'assurer que toutes les données sont à jour dans SAP HR et qu'elles sont le point de contact avec l'équipe de la paie et de l'assurance sur des sujets pertinents tels que : l'embarquement et le départ, le transfert interne et le suivi des dossiers du personnel et des procédures des RH (détails personnels, poste, salaire, résultats d'évaluation, dossiers de congés, formation et bourses) conformément aux lois et politiques. En regardant les solutions numériques, en cherchant une amélioration continue de nos méthodes de travail et d'excellence opérationnelle. jobs.title: Europe FP&A Controller
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128623 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Europe FP&A controller is responsible for financial planning and analysis of the full Europe region for one or two defined Maison(s) of the Group as well as of the wholesale business in Europe for a defined scope of Maisons. This role involves being a key financial partner for Europe Maison Management and Finance teams to support business operations and decision making. This position is a 6-month fixed-term position starting in July 2026 until end of December 2026. Reporting to Europe FP&A Manager, the position is based in Meyrin, Geneva, within our ‘Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie’. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Europe Maison FP&A The regional controller is responsible for the consolidation, review and challenge of the local forecasts to ensure alignment with HQ and Maison European management guidelines. Reporting: Consolidation of the Europe markets’ financial statements to report to Maison HQ as well as to Maison European Management. Analytical review of actuals vs forecasts, interact with appropriate stakeholders to understand/correct deviations, and ensure business commentary Planning: Consolidate, analyze and challenge figures to ensure Maison forecasts are in line with the Region / Maison Depending on the Maison, present the Annual budget to the Maison Exco along with the Europe Management Europe Wholesale Financial Planning Coordinate the consolidation of the full P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons Adjust budget figures based on quarterly reviews with the appropriate stakeholders Communicate forecasts and gap analysis to the Maisons HQ Europe Wholesale Monthly Closing & Reporting Activities Perform analytical reviews on the P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons and report results with comments to Maisons’ HQ Develop and maintain financial reporting to proactively support Maisons’ decision-making processes Support the Management Reporting process (upload and reconcile actual monthly results into the system for consolidation) Run various checks and corrections to ensure accurate closing in line with IFRS Operations Act as a true business partner and strengthen the relationship with Maisons Ensure continuous improvement of business processes to gain efficiency in the organization Support Richemont Europe Management in various ad-hoc requests Participate actively in controlling ad-hoc projects (e.g. system automation, community management, closing process improvements, digitalization, cash-flow guidance, etc.) HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are able to thrive in a complex fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, balance multiple priorities while still contribute thoughtful and high-quality work. You are result oriented with appetite for efficiency through reports automation. You are a strong team player with the ability to communicate and build relationships with various internal partners including Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. You work well in group problem-solving situations and generate creative solutions. You want to learn quickly with a strong analytic & critical mind-set. CONTEXTE Le contrôleur Europe FP&A est responsable de la planification financière et de l’analyse de l’ensemble de la région Europe pour une ou deux Maisons définies du Groupe ainsi que de l’activité de gros en Europe pour un champ d’action défini des Maisons. Ce rôle consiste à être un partenaire financier clé pour les équipes de gestion et de finance de Europe Maison afin de soutenir les opérations commerciales et la prise de décision. Ce poste est un emploi à durée déterminée de 6 mois débutant en juillet 2026 jusqu’à fin décembre 2026. Relevant du responsable FP&A en Europe, le poste est basé à Meyrin, Genève, au sein de notre « Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie ». COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Europe Maison FP&A Le contrôleur régional est responsable de la consolidation, de la révision et de la mise en question des prévisions locales afin d’assurer l’alignement avec les directives de gestion du siège et de Maison Europe. Vous pouvez vous épanouir dans un environnement complexe et rapide sous des délais serrés, équilibrer plusieurs priorités tout en contribuant avec un travail réfléchi et de haute qualité. Vous êtes orienté vers les résultats avec un appétit pour l’efficacité grâce à l’automatisation des rapports. Vous êtes un bon joueur d’équipe, capable de communiquer et de créer des relations avec divers partenaires internes, y compris Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. Vous travaillez bien dans des situations de groupe pour résoudre des problèmes et générer des solutions créatives. Vous voulez apprendre rapidement avec un esprit analytique et critique fort. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement international et diversifié, avec une forte exposition au Top Management. Tu es capable d’être autonome et autonome. Alors, vous devez être le bon talent pour rejoindre notre équipe régionale en tant que Contrôleur FP&A Europe. Diplôme de Master en finance ou administration des affaires ou équivalent minimum de 5 ans, expérience confirmée en finance (FP&A, contrôle ou audit). Expérience dans l’industrie du luxe plus une maîtrise de l’anglais, toute langue supplémentaire est un avantage. Vous avez des compétences avancées en Excel, vous êtes capable d’effectuer des analyses dans des outils financiers et analytiques (connaissances de SAP et Business Warehouse). Les compétences automatisées et numériques sont un atout. QU’EST-CE QUI REND NOTRE GROUPE DIFFÉRENT ? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la grande diversité de nos arts, nos cultures et nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à favoriser un potentiel inexploité. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous favorisons l’empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l’humilité et l’intégrité. - Nous nous soucions du monde dans lequel nous vivons. jobs.description: Reference code: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos collaborateurs de tous horizons partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement exceptionnels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de connaisseurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Be One Of Not Many FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager who will be responsible for generating qualitative high value sales (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) by developing his own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, cultivating strong relationships and leveraging the Maison hospitality platform, whilst also recruiting new clients/UHNWI. Collaboratively with international markets, this role will develop and treat VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visiting our Manufacture in Geneva, and other regional locations. Based in our Manufacture in Plan-les-Ouates and reporting to High Watchmaking Client Director, this role will work cross functionally (HQ and Markets) at Europe level. The High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager plays a key and strategic role in growing our Maison reputation and desirability within the region. PLAYING YOUR PART Drive Client strategy and support Clients' development You will drive qualitative high value/Les Cabinotiers sales, in line with the Maison’s strategy and scarcity guidelines You will work off-site to grow your clients' network and to recruit new clients You will refer prospects to Boutiques in their home Market and support their Client journey You will work hand in hand with Boutiques to ensure the highest level of service before, during and after the sale when needed. You will manage VIC/VVIC clients' complaints and offer solutions Collaboratively with European/International markets, you will leverage Maison opportunities including the Hospitality platform, deliver unique and tailor-made Client experience You will work closely and support Boutique Managers within the Europe/International region, on coaching and developing their Sales team to grow the VIC/VVIC client base Define yearly action plans to recruit new Clients and contribute to the development of existing ones You will develop your own VIC/VVIC client portfolio, propose and align action plans to increase loyalty and develop high value/Les Cabinotiers sales You will assess market opportunities and potential to target and acquire new Clients; pro-actively suggest new development opportunities (event/places/intermediaries) to recruit new VIC/VVIC Clients You will evaluate existing Client’s journey and development within the markets/within the region, in particular sleeping VIC/VVIC clients, and contribute to (re-)activate them Support HQ Hospitality team You will work hand in hand with Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager to support Hospitality plans for their VIC/VVIC clients coming to Geneva You will host Clients in Switzerland out of the Manufacture, during diners, events, fairs or dedicated activations, and host them in the Manufacture together with Hospitality Clients Manager You will share post Clients’ activities/events analyses and reports with markets for local follow-up You will participate in local, regional and international Maison Events, acting as our Ambassador You will participate and be proactive in the enrichment of the Client experience offer, Hospitality services and overall Client treatment You will pass on knowledge to other Client Relationship Managers/Grand Vendeurs/Sales teams You will contribute to the administration of the Manufacture Salon-Boutique in daily operations (invoicing, shipping, after sales service, inventory, stock management in full compliance with the Maison and Richemont guidelines) together with the Hospitality Clients Manager WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require A solid 10+ years’ experience in Sales with proven records in managing VIC/VVIC Clients acquisition, engagement through strong partnerships and retention Self-entrepreneur and a self-motivated person, agile, broad-scanner, critical thinker, with ability to innovate, drive change and work autonomously Excellent knowledge of luxury Market, including watchmaking and jewellery brands, luxury fashion and trends and latest news in town and in the world Elegance, Passion, Generosity, Audacity, and Quest for Excellence, with excellent presentation skills and a high sense of client privacy & Maison’s confidentiality Proactivity with a “get-it-done” results-driven attitude, autonomy and ability to work independently to achieve the goals whilst being a strong team player for transverse activation - with a positive and resilient attitude Flexibility towards international travels Fluency in French and English, any other language a plus Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR128696 Dans l'univers de la Maison, nos collaborurs de tous orizzonti partagent avec passion un but commun : la quête permanente de l'excellence portée par les compétences et l'engagement eccezioninels des femmes et des hommes qui travaillent dans notre Manufacture. Maison de conosciurs en Haute Horlogerie, Vacheron Constantin n'a jamais cessé, au cours de ses plus de 269 ans d'histoire, de se créer, de s'enrichir et de se réinventer. Siate uno dei non molti per il pensiero che vede l'ESCELLENZA Unisciti a una delle Maison più rispettate nell'orologeria dove l'eccellenza è sia una data che una ricerca senza fine. Gioca la tua parte nella guida del nostro successo collettivo. Il tuo!
• Stiamo cercando un High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager che sarà responsabile della generazione di vendite ad alto valore qualitativo (exceptional/Les Cabinotiers timepieces) sviluppando il proprio portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, coltivando forti relazioni e sfruttando la piattaforma di ospitalità della Maison, reclutando anche nuovi clienti/UHNWI. Collaborativamente con i mercati internazionali, questo ruolo svilupperà e tratterà VIC/VVIC/UHNWI visitando la nostra Manifattura a Ginevra, e altre sedi regionali. Sulla base della nostra Manifattura in Plan-les-Ouates e della relazione al Direttore clienti di alta qualità dell'orologeria, questo ruolo funzionerà in modo funzionale (HQ e Markets) a livello europeo. L'High Watchmaking Client Relationship Manager svolge un ruolo chiave e strategico nella crescita della nostra reputazione e della disabilità della Maison all'interno della regione. Pianificare la strategia del cliente e sostenere lo sviluppo dei clienti Guiderete le vendite qualitative di alta qualità/Les Cabinotiers, in linea con la strategia della Maison e le linee guida di scarsità Potrai lavorare fuori sede per crescere la rete dei tuoi clienti e per reclutare nuovi clienti Riferirete le prospettive di Boutique nel loro mercato domestico e sostenere il loro viaggio cliente Potrai lavorare di pari passo con Boutique per garantire il più alto livello di servizio prima, durante e dopo la vendita quando necessario. Gestirete i reclami dei clienti VIC/VVIC e offrirete soluzioni In collaborazione con i mercati europei / internazionali, potrete sfruttare le opportunità di Maison tra cui la piattaforma Hospitality, fornire un'esperienza clienti unica e su misura Si lavorerà a stretto contatto e supporterà Boutique Manager all'interno della regione Europa / Internazionale, su coaching e sviluppo del loro team di vendita per crescere la base clienti VIC / VVIC Definire piani di azione annuali per reclutare nuovi clienti e contribuire allo sviluppo di quelli esistenti Svilupperai il tuo portafoglio clienti VIC/VVIC, proporrai e allineerai i piani d'azione per aumentare la lealtà e sviluppare un alto valore/Les Cabinotiers sales Valuterai le opportunità di mercato e il potenziale per indirizzare e acquisire nuovi Clienti; pro-attivamente suggerisci nuove opportunità di sviluppo (event/places/intermediaries) per reclutare nuovi clienti VIC/VVIC Valuterai il viaggio e lo sviluppo dei clienti esistenti all’interno dei mercati/all’interno della regione, in particolare i clienti VIC/VVIC che dormono, e contribuiranno (ri-)attivarli Support HQ Hospitality team Si lavorerà di pari passo con Markets and Hospitality Clients Manager per sostenere i piani di ospitalità per i loro clienti VIC/VVIC che verranno a Ginevra. Condividerai attività/eventi dei Clienti analisi e rapporti con i mercati per il follow-up locale Parteciperai a eventi di Maison locali, regionali e internazionali, in qualità di nostro Ambasciatore parteciperai e sarai proattivo nell'arricchimento dell'offerta di esperienza del cliente, dei servizi di accoglienza e del trattamento generale del cliente Passerai la conoscenza ad altri gestori di relazioni cliente/Grand Vendeurs/Sales team Contribuirai all'amministrazione del Salone-Boutique della Manifattura nelle operazioni quotidiane (fattura, spedizione, servizio post-vendita, inventario, gestione delle scorte nel pieno rispetto delle linee guida Maison e Richemont) insieme al Gestore Clienti dell'OspitalitÃ CHE COSA MAKE TU SUCCESSFUL? Il successo in questo ruolo richiederà un solido 10+ anni di esperienza in vendite con record comprovati nella gestione di VIC/VVIC Clients acquisizione, l'impegno attraverso partnership forti e la ritenzione Self-entrepreneur e una persona auto-motivated, agile, broad-scanner, pensatore critico, con la capacità di innovare, guidare il cambiamento e lavorare autonomamente Eccellente conoscenza del mercato di lusso, tra cui l'orologeria e marchi di gioielli, tendenze di moda e di lusso e di moda e di moda e le ultime notizie Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, gestiamo una rete globale di vendita al dettaglio di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità globale di orologiai, artigiani e professionisti dedicati condividono una comune devozione al nostro patrimonio eccezionale e alla passione per la sciabola di un futuro ancora più luminoso. Se questo accende la vostra immaginazione, accogliamo la vostra applicazione.
